上銀(2049.TT) 
AI 與半導體需求強勁，精密線性傳動元件交期持續拉長

AI 與半導體需求強勁，帶動工具機新一波的景氣循環，上銀生產
的精密線性傳動元件大量用於 AI 與半導體設備 ， 在半導體產業CapEx
確立的情況下，預期這波拉貨潮將延續至明年。在上一波 2021-22 年
的上升循環中，股價最高來到當年度 EPS 的 45 倍，考量到目前僅出
現第一波漲價，研究部以 2027 年 EPS 13.16 元給予 35x 本益比，目
標價為 460 元，給予買進的評等。

1. 半導體設備需求強勁，帶動工具機新一波的景氣循環 
上銀生產的線性滑軌與滾珠螺桿大量應用於 AI 與半導體設備當中，這
波景氣上升循環由從 4Q25 開始，拉貨動能逐季提升。從交期來看，線
性滑軌的交期從去年年底 3 個月，拉長到現在的 4~5 個月；滾珠螺桿
交期從去年年底 4 個月，拉長到現在 5~6 個月。從營收來看，扣除 2
月份有過年因素外 (去年過年在 1 月)，上銀的月營收 YoY 從 3 月的
17.4%一路提升到 8 月的 42.3%，此期間沒有縮小過，顯示營收不但在
成長，成長的動能還在加速。公司亦提到從 6 月開始 BB raio 大於 1，
需求非常強勁，已開始規劃明年過年期間要如何加班生產。研究部看好
這波由 AI 與半導體帶動的工具機需求延續至明年，預估上銀 2026/27
年營收為 300.1/378.2 億元，+23.7%/+26.0% YoY。

2. 市場供不應求，交期持續拉長看好後續漲價機會 
市場供不應求 ， 公司於今年3 月宣布調漲 7~15%， 已於6 月開始反應 。
2Q26 毛利率 34.2%，季增 2.2 個百分點，為稼動率與價格同步提升所
致，預估 3Q26 漲價效應完全反應後毛利率將進一步提升至 35.2%，研
究部預估上銀 2026/27 年的毛利率為 34.3%/35.6%， 分別年增5.5/1.3
個百分點，EPS 為 9.56/13.16 元，+121.7%/+37.6% YoY。 
這波由半導體產業 CapEx 所帶動的景氣上升，研究部看好在交期不斷拉長
的情況下，後續還有漲價、上修毛利率的機會。(上一波 2021-2022 年上升
循環中毛利率最高來到 37-38%)

一、 一、公司介紹 
   上銀科技成立於 1989 年 ， 專注於線性滑軌 、 滾珠螺桿與單軸機器人等精密線性
傳動元件的製造 ， 為該領域的全球領導廠商之一 。 除了持續研發線性傳動產品以外 ，
也自行開發出多種半導體自動化設備 ，產品廣泛應用於汽車 、 半導體 、 醫療 、 國防 、
航太及食品等產業。上銀憑藉自有品牌 「HIWIN」 的深厚研發實力與品質行銷全世
界，目前為全球第二大生產線性滑軌與滾珠螺桿的廠商，第一大為日商 THK 
(6481.T)。1H26 產品營收占比﹔線性滑軌 60%、 滾珠螺桿20%、 工業機器人12%、
其他 8%。2025 年地區營收占比﹔台灣 44%、中國 21%、德國 16%、美國 5%、
日本 4%、其他 10%。(地區營收 2025 年已是最新公布)

二、 產業分析 
上銀主要產品為線性滑軌與滾珠螺桿，產品功能如下﹔ 
1. 線性滑軌﹔一種線性傳動元件，由滑塊與滑軌組成，透過內部的滾珠或滾  
柱循環系統來降低摩擦，讓平台保持平行穩定的直線運動。  
2. 滾珠螺桿﹔一種線性傳動元件，由螺桿、螺帽與鋼珠組成，利用鋼珠在螺桿與
螺帽間循環滾動，將旋轉運動轉換為直線運動。

商業模式 
線性滑軌與滾珠螺桿為工具機零組件 ， 工具機產業商業模式分為以下三種 (以 AOI
檢測設備為例)﹔ 
1. 工具機零組件廠生產線性滑軌 ➨ 工具機 OEM 廠將各零組件組裝成五軸加工
機 ➨ 設備零組件廠用五軸加工機生產高精度定位平台  ➨ 設備商用高精度定位
平台與其他零組件組裝成 AOI 檢測設備。  
2. 工具機零組件廠生產線性滑軌 ➨ 工具機 OEM 廠將各零組件組裝成五軸加工
機 ➨ 設備商用五軸加工機自行生產所需的高精度定位平台或其他零組件。 
3. 工具機零組件廠生產的線性滑軌同時是工具機零組件與設備零組件  ➨ 設備
商直接購買線性滑軌來組裝。

產業趨勢 
JMTBA (日本工具機協會) 每月會將日本所有工具機 OEM 廠的訂單加總 ， 公布 「日
本工具機訂單金額」 ，其產品包含多軸加工機、CNC 車床、滾齒機……等等，由於
日本擁有全球規模前幾大的工具機 OEM 廠，如 DMG、Yamazaki、Okuma，且多
年來產品遍布各個產業所累積的經驗也使得這些公司不論在自研控制器的演算
法，還是機器長時間運轉下維持的精度與溫度都與其他國家有技術上的差距。  
因此，在各行各業景氣轉好，需要大量的工具機時，JMTBA 公布的訂單金額被視
為是工具機產業最重要的觀察指標，工具機 OEM 廠訂單增加 ➨ 增加向工具機
零組件廠的拉貨。 
觀察過去十年日本工具機訂單的走勢，可發現景氣大約呈現兩年上升、兩年下降
的循環。上一次的上升週期為 2021-22 年疫情加上塞港，全球各產業瘋狂拉貨，
使得工具機訂單 YoY 從 2020/11 的-6%，最高拉升到 2021/5 的 142%，一直到
2022/10 訂單 YoY 才轉負 。 塞港造成的恐慌式補庫存為工具機產業帶來20 年來不
曾有過的成長率 ， 也使得隨後各產業去化庫存時 ， 工具機這次的景氣休息得較久 ，
直到 2H25 才再次迎來上升週期。

而在此波的上升週期，生產線性滑軌與滾珠螺桿等工具機零組件全球市占前二的
廠商，THK、上銀一致提到這一次的需求來自 AI 與半導體，且需求非常強勁。 
細看 AI 與半導體產業，其中涵蓋了相當多工具機的蹤跡，舉凡伺服器散熱所需的
水冷板、快接頭及熱交換器，到伺服器機殼、Compute/GPU Tray 與各種結構件，
都需要以工具機進行切削或沖壓。半導體產業中，在製程升級與產能擴充的過程
需要大量的半導體設備 ，不論在前 、 中 、 後段的設備都須使用線性傳動元件 ， 如蝕
刻機、AOI 檢測設備、各類型 Bonder 等等。 
產品規格方面，AI 與半導體所需的工具機精度更高，使得 THK、上銀這種技術領
先的廠商進一步受惠 。 一般工業用工具機僅需使用H/N 級的線性滑軌與 C5/C7 級
的滾珠螺桿，生產水冷板與快接頭時需使用 SP/P 級的線性滑軌與 C3 級的滾珠螺
桿；在Die Bonder (晶粒鍵合機)與 Flip Chip Bonder (倒裝鍵合機)上則需使用 UP/SP
級的線性滑軌與 C0/C1 級的滾珠螺桿，生產高精度的線性滑軌與滾珠螺桿毛利率
顯著高於精度較低的。

滑軌與滾珠螺桿 ，大銀微提供各類馬達 、 定位平台 、 驅動器與運動控制器等等 ，產
品包含 EFEM ( 晶圓移載系統 )、Load Port ( 晶圓裝卸機)、Wafer Robot ( 晶圓機器
人) 、Wafer Aligner (晶圓尋邊器)，目前認列於機器人營收當中，產能滿載，直接
出貨給半導體製程廠商。

小結 
歷經 2022 年後的全球各產業庫存去化，工具機景氣委靡了接近三年的期間，如
今挾帶著 AI 伺服器與半導體設備需求強勁成長，再次迎來新一波景氣上升循環。
從水冷板、快接頭到各類半導體設備，皆帶動工具機需求快速升溫， 相關廠商也
同步指出需求強勁、訂單持續增加，交期明顯拉長。 
更重要的是，這波需求主要來自半導體設備等高精度應用領域，所需線性滑軌與
滾珠螺桿規格高於一般工業產品，上銀除受惠於工具機景氣重新向上外，亦可進
一步受惠於高規格精密線性傳動元件需求成長。

VPEC’s Jul and Aug revenue delivered double digit YoY growth, or 
23% / 25% higher than our estimate, reflecting strong AI data center 
optical networking demand, InP substrate supply getting better, and 
VPEC’s continuous customers penetration. We expect sequential 
revenues growth through Dec 2026, leading 3Q26 / 4Q26E revenues 
at 44% / 23% QoQ, and the product mix upgrade toward AI data 
center optical networking would continue to drive the GM 
expansion. VPEC’s July net margin up to 27% from 18% / 22% in 
3Q25 / 2Q26, reflecting the strong product mix upgrade. Maintain 
Buy with 12M TP raised to NT$793 (implied 69x 2027E PE vs. +61% 
NI YoY in 2027-28E). Read more: Global Optical Module TAM.

### Page 3

Earnings revision: We factor in VPEC’s Jul-Aug revenues and raise our 2026-28E net 
incomes by 12% / 18% / 30%, mainly on higher revenues and GMs. 2026-28E revenues 
are revised up by 7% / 14% / 25%, mainly on higher contribution from optoelectronics 
business, driven by the strong end demand of AI data center optical networking, better 
InP substrate supply, and VPEC’s customers’ expansion and product expansion from CW 
lasers to EML, along with specification upgrade. Our 2026-28E GMs are revised up on 
rising contribution from optoelectronics business, which carries a higher margin than 
other product lines. We revise up 2027-28E opex ratios, mainly on higher R&D expense 
to collaborate with key customers on next generation optical networking products.

at 10.5% COE (no change), and derive target PE multiple from refreshed peers’ trading

NI YoY of 18% (vs. 20% previously) and 2029-30E OPM of 38% (vs. 37% previously), and 
peers’ PEG&M of 0.4x (vs. 0.3x previously), we derive target PE multiple at 22.2x (vs.

### Page 8

VPEC focuses on III-V compound semiconductor EPI wafer for microelectronics and 
optoelectronics devices based on InP and GaA substrate, and expands to EPI wafer for 
SiPh transceivers CW laser for data center applications. We expect strong momentum in 
VPEC growth driven by the SiPh ramp up in 2026E, microelectronics clients’ increasing 
demand, and its accumulated technology advantages on EPI wafer. We note that VPEC is 
currently trading lower than our TP implied 69x 2027E forward P/E, which is attractive, 
in our view.  
Price Target Risks and Methodology - VPEC 
Valuation: We adopt a discounted P/E method and apply a 22.2x target P/E on VPEC’s 
2029E EPS, discounting back to 2027E at a COE of 10.5% (beta 1.7x, risk free rate 1.6% 
and market risk premium at 5.1%), to derive our 12m TP of NT$793. Our target P/E is 
based on 0.4x PEG&M ratio derived from the average level of peers in the photonics 
supply chain. 
Key risk: Slower-than-expected SiPh business ramp up; weaker-than-expected 
microelectronics demand from smartphones clients; IDM offers EPI wafer in-house.

Accton Technology Corporation  | Asia Pacific
August Sales +4% MoM/+59%
YoY
In this report, we focus on Accton's monthly sales, which we
believe could be a catalyst for share price movement.
Details:
• August sales were NT$40,873mn (+4% MoM/+59% YoY).
• QTD reached 66% of our 3Q26 estimate, at NT$120,883mn (+27% QoQ/
+66% YoY), and 70% of consensus, at NT$114,321mn (+20% QoQ/+57%
YoY).
Our view:
• We see 3Q26 revenue tracking in line with our estimates

• Our checks indicate that Accton has been negotiating with customers to let
them consign  those expensive components, which could weigh on its
revenue growth but should be positive to margins.
• Looking ahead, we expect the momentum to remain elevated into 2H26, as it
should benefit from broader-based migration to 800G network switches
from both existing and new customers, and the ramp of the new AI
accelerator model from its major customer should be in full swing.

• Stay OW with a PT of NT$3,500, based on 30x 2027 P/E.

Valuation Methodology and Risks
Accton Technology Corporation (2345.TW)
Base case, P/E, which we believe better captures the company's earnings growth momentum.
We assign a target P/E of 30x to our 2027 EPS estimate, which we view as justified by an
operating profit CAGR of 48% for 2025-28, based on our estimates. This implies a PEG of
around 0.6, vs. its average of 0.7 over 2019-25, when the stock was trading at a P/E of 22x for

an operating profit CAGR of 32%.

Chroma Ate Inc.  | Asia Pacific
August  Sales  +4% MoM/+156%
YoY
In this report, we focus on Chroma's monthly sales, which we
believe could be a catalyst for share price movement.
Details:
• August revenue was NT$5,632mn (+4% MoM/+156% YoY).
• QTD revenue reached 75% of MSe, at NT$14,772mn (+9% QoQ/+130% YoY),
and 79% of consensus, at NT$13,992mn (+3% QoQ/+118% YoY).
Our view:
• We see 3Q26 tracking ahead of market expectations and likely to deliver

over 20% QoQ.
• Looking ahead, we expect its power testing business to stay at an elevated
level, and the semiconductor & photonics business to continue growing HoH
into 2H26, driven by SLT, metrology, CPO and potential shipment of FT
handlers/burn-in ovens.
• Stay OW.

Morgan Stanley Research 3
Valuation Methodology and Risks
Chroma Ate Inc. (2360.TW)
Base case, 45x 2027e P/E. We use P/E as our valuation methodology because we think it better
captures Chroma's earnings growth momentum. The stock traded at an average valuation of
~19x P/E during 2014-25 with an operating profit CAGR of 20%, implying a PEG of 1.0. We think
our target multiple of 45x is justified by the 61% operating profit CAGR we project for

2025-28.
Risks to Upside
n Better-than-expected macro conditions
n Stronger semi and photonics and power testing demand
n Margin improvement via better product mix
n Better opex control
Risks to Downside
n Macro slowdown
n Softer-than-expected AI capex
n Slower progress in the advanced packaging capacity expansion
n Weaker consumer electronics and automobile related demand
n Margin contraction arising from lack of revenue scale and increasing opex

•2027 Pricing Looks More Favorable.  Management hopes to implement broader-based price increases across AI and
non-AI products to offset higher wafer, energy and other input costs and support new capacity investments. Pricing
should therefore turn more positive in 2027 if utilization remains high. Management noted that every 1% ASP
increase could improve gross margin by roughly 0.5–0.6ppt. However, margins are unlikely to revisit the >45%

COVID-era peak because depreciation is structurally higher following the current investment cycle.
•Intel 12nm cooperation: Capital-Light Path, contribution starting in late 2027 . The Intel collaboration is
strategically important because it gives UMC a capital-light path from its strong 22/28nm franchise into 12nm. Intel
provides existing Arizona manufacturing equipment and capacity, while UMC contributes technology conversion, RD
resources and its existing customer relationships. Initial customers are primarily Wi-Fi and communications-related,

with the first meaningful revenue expected around late 2027; broader contribution should build gradually thereafter
as customers validate the first wave. UMC expects to book the wafer revenue, with Intel manufacturing costs flowing
through UMC’s cost structure and economics broadly shared between the two parties. Expansion into smaller nodes
or advanced packaging with Intel remains possible, but management stressed that 12nm must first demonstrate

competitive yield, manufacturing performance and profitability.
•Silicon Photonics: Singapore Fab Becomes a Major AI Growth Platform.  The company is building dedicated 12-inch
capacity for silicon photonics in Singapore, with the new facility expected to be ready in roughly 14 months.  The
platform can encompass PICs and related components such as TIA, with management describing demand as
stronger than its available engineering resources.  UMC also has exposure to TFLN through an affiliate focused

initially on 6-inch technology, with potential migration to 8-inch manufacturing supported by UMC. Current
economics are attractive because photonics wafers can command multiples of conventional CMOS wafer pricing.
Longer term, UMC wants to combine silicon photonics, specialty materials and packaging capabilities into an
integrated platform.
•Advanced Packaging: Building an Open-Ecosystem Second Source. Advanced packaging represents UMC’s third
major structural growth driver. Rather than competing directly with TSMC’s fully integrated leading-edge ecosystem,

UMC aims to become a credible second-source, open-ecosystem provider. Its developing capabilities include
interposers, wafer-to-wafer and hybrid bonding, DTC, and related packaging processes, with silicon photonics
potentially integrated into the same broader solution. UMC is constructing two new advanced-packaging facilities in
Taiwan. Construction is expected to take more than two years, while existing facilities can provide limited capacity
during the interim.

•Specialty Strategy Provides Defense Against China Competition. UMC continues to differentiate itself through
specialty technologies rather than competing primarily on commodity mature-node capacity. Management
estimates 50–60%+ of revenue now comes from specialty processes, which provides meaningful insulation from
Chinese foundry pricing pressure. China’s semiconductor market is also becoming increasingly segmented into
“China-for-China” and “non-China-for-non-China” supply chains, limiting direct cross-border price competition.

UMC’s two China fabs remain highly utilized and represent roughly 10% of group capacity. Overall, UMC’s strategy is
shifting from being primarily a mature-node foundry toward a specialty and heterogeneous-integration platform
while improving utilization and pricing provide a stronger cyclical backdrop for 2027.

UMC
Valuation
Our target price for UMC of NT$125 is based on 15x 2027E EPS, which is higher than the midpoint of its 3-year forward PE. We
believe our target multiple is justified by our belief that UMC should benefit from the robust demand in 22/28nm, TSMC's
increasing order outflow opportunity, long-term opportunity in advanced packaging and photonics and that its niche
technology offerings should help it outperform its trailing-edge foundry peers. Our target price equates to 2026E/27E PB of

3.5x/3.2x.
Risks
Key downside risks to our target price include: 1) a longer-than-expected demand recovery; 2) more competition from peers in
28nm; 3) worse-than-expected developments from the company's China investment; 4) a significant decline in smartphone
end-demand; 5) poor contribution from Novatek's iPhone OLED business; and 6) fiercer ASP competition from Chinese peers.

Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

has made the stocks overvalued.
The iPhone opportunity is real for Largan and Genius…but their stocks have
rallied 48% and 85%, respectively, in the past month: (The TAIEX is up 5% over
this period.)
We now value Largan at NT$7,100/share – no longer attractive: Our analysis
suggests that Largan's current share price already embeds more than 30% global
market share in Fiber Array Units (FAU) before formal production starts in 2H27 or
even 2028. Our residual income model yields a value of NT$3,000/share for the

company's traditional business, while our TAM analysis derives a value of NT$4,100/
share for CPO/FAU new business, bringing the total price target to NT$7,100.
However, any delay in CPO/FAU development poses significant downside risk. We
therefore downgrade to EW.
We now value Genius at NT$910/share – but  even on this basis, we view it as
overvalued: Similarly, we believe Genius's share price is also inflated by hopes for
FAU components. Using a similar approach, we conclude that aggregate value is NT

$910/share (NT$600 for existing business and NT$310/share for FAU component
business). We recommend taking profits.
Reiterate OW on Luxshare, Lingyi, Crystal and AAC: We believe all four companies
will benefit from the new iPhone launch. Here, however,  we still see upside in the
stocks. We see these companies, benefiting in various ways:
• Luxshare: Key player in iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max assembly, also benefits from
variable aperture upgrade as component supplier.

•  Lingyi: Higher content value form both iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max and foldable.
•  Crystal: Micro prism modules, coated filters, and cover lenses should enjoy
positive ASP and volume growth.
• AAC: Vapor chamber (VC) heat dissipation upgrade for iPhone 18 Pro Max
and Pro is the key catalyst.
Remain EW on Sunny Optical and GoerTek: Sunny is a key variable aperture
component vendor, but it's been well on track to meet the goal of doubling revenue,
implying limited upside surprise. GoerTek could face labor shortages and margin

Implications from iPhone 18 Launch for Various Supply
Chain Companies
Camera spec upgrade is a positive earnings driver, but CPO
enthusiasm has made Largan and Genius overvalued
The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max have applied a variable aperture main camera for the first
time, representing a significant hardware upgrade.  The ASP of  variable aperture lenses will
be higher than it is for traditional lenses. Thus, a rapid shipment increase in 3Q26 could

become a key re-rating catalyst – indeed, it has already prompted sharp re-rating for
Largan, Genius, and Sunny.
Besides this, the launch of Apple's first foldable iPhone will also provide an incremental
demand driver beyond the standard iPhone 18 lineup. According to Nikkei Asia (link),
foldable smartphone orders increased from 8 million units to 10 million units this year,
and if the new product performs well in 4Q2026, it could become a positive catalyst for

Apple supply chain companies.
Beyond variable aperture and foldable, the further development of a new periscope lens
with the key customer is likely to expand  these use of periscope lenses in the future. This
could also become a positive driver for optical lens companies in the supply chain.
1. Largan: iPhone opportunity is real, but recent enthusiasm
over CPO made valuation too aggressive – downgrade to EW
Largan's revenue follows a well-established seasonal pattern tied to Apple's annual iPhone

launch cycle. After shipments declined continuously from March 2026 through June 2026,
we expect a seasonal recovery to begin in 3Q26, with sequential increases highly likely in
the following months. Largan's August 2026 consolidated revenue reached NT$5.012
billion, up 3% month-over-month and its best performance in four months, and the
company expects September's shipment momentum to surpass August's.
Largan is a key supplier of variable aperture lenses for the iPhone 18 Pro series, and the

company could also benefit from foldable and periscope opportunities, we raise our
intrinsic value estimate of the company's traditional business from NT$2,814/share to NT
$3,000/share. For more details, please refer to Exhibit 18.
Besides the Apple lens opportunity, we believe Largan's share performance is also highly
correlated to CPO development. In order to assess the fundamental value from the CPO
opportunity, we undertook the following analysis:

1. We forecast CPO optical engine volume to increase from 0.39mn in 2026 to
7.78mn in 2027,with a further surge to 48.6mn in 2028. Consequently, FAU (Fiber
Array Units – vital optical interconnect components that align multiple optical
fibers with silicon chips, making them critical for Co-Packaged Optics) volume for
CPO also grows from 0.39 to 48.6 mn for the same period of time;
2. We assume ASP of US$100 in 2026-2028 (average market level);
3. We forecast Largan's FAU market share to increase from 0% in 2026 to 5% in

### Page 6

2027 and 40% in 2028 (previously 20%).
4. Assuming net margins of 10% in 2027 and 30% in 2028, we forecast FAU earnings
of US$4mn in 2027 and US$579 mn in 2028.
If we value the FAU business at 35x 2028e P/E (industry peers are at 40-50x P/E, and
considering the first year of scalable production), it could bring incremental market cap of
US$20.278bn. Discounting it back to 2026 at a 10% rate, we derive a per-share positive
impact of NT$4,100.

We hold a positive view on Largan's CPO/FAU business opportunity because the company
has a superior track record of high precision manufacturing relative to most industry peers
in Taiwan. However, our calculation above suggests that the current share price already
reflects Largan's potential  to attain >30% global market share for FAU products.
Meanwhile, formal production hasn't kicked off yet – it is more likely to start in the

second half of 2027 or even 2028. Therefore, any delay in CPO/FAU development could
result in significant share price fluctuation. Considering current risk-reward, even after
raising our price target 47%, we no longer view Largan as attractive any more in view of
the recent strong share price performance. We set our price target at NT$7,100, within
which NT$3,000 is from its traditional business and NT$4,100 is from CPO/FAU new
business.

3. Sunny: Apple revenue to double in 2026, but positive is

We believe Sunny Optical will benefit from the new iPhone launch because:
1. The company is a key vendor of  variable aperture actuators – a key spec upgrade

with higher ASP.
2. Sunny is expanding the product mix from a single category to multiple categories,
which could generate higher revenue from the key client.
3. Sunny is also gaining share in high-end lens products.
These drivers collectively underpin management's guidance of doubling  Apple revenue for

However, the fundamental performance is in line with management's guidance, so there is

4. Crystal: Prisms, coated filters, and cover lenses to benefit
We expect Crystal Optech to benefit from Apple's new product launch because  the
company is supplying three key products in the supply chain:
1. Its micro prism modules are a key enabling component for periscope (folded-

optics) telephoto cameras in smartphones. The company's prism technology uses a
folded optical path to achieve long-focal-length telephoto capability without
increasing device thickness. In 1H26, the micro prism module business enjoyed
significant volume growth. The iPhone 18 launch will directly extend this demand
into 2H26.
2. Crystal-Optech's coated filter business — which brings micro-nano optical
processing into the IRCF manufacturing process to significantly improve petal

ghosting and chromatic aberration in special imaging scenarios — is another key
segment that benefits from the iPhone 18 launch. Apple's high-end Pro models are
the primary application for this product, so the company is highly likely to
generate rapid revenue and earnings growth.
3. The iPhone 18 Pro models are expected to feature advances in 3D sensing,
including a smaller Dynamic Island as some Face ID components move beneath the
display, which sustains demand for these optical components. Crystal Optech is

well positioned to capture the growth opportunity in iPhone's 3D sensing and
cover lenses.
The company's 2Q26 results were a bit weaker than we expected because of rising costs
from R&D and capacity expansion related to new products. However, we believe this
investment could lead to stronger growth in 2028 and onward. As a result, we trim our
earnings estimates 15.6% for 2026 and 2.9% for 2027 but raise our 2028 estimate 8.2%.
Consequently, we raise our price target  7%, to Rmb32, implying 24% upside from the

current level.

growth intact
We believe Luxshare's Apple opportunity is underappreciated –  some investors worry
about the supply chain relocation. However, the company is one of Apple's most deeply

We expect Luxshare to benefit from the latest new product  launch through the following

four key drivers:
1.  Second largest assembler for iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max — the most premium-heavy
iPhone lineup in history. If the  Pro/Pro Max models can take 70%+ of total iPhone
volume, it could mark the highest high-end model contribution over the past
several model cycles. A higher share from high-end models implies better revenue
and margin outlook for Luxshare.
2.   Capturing component opportunity in new  variable aperture actuator supply.

Instead of doing assembly, Lxushare is also playing the role  of supplier of actuator
mechanisms for the variable aperture camera system in the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro
Max. This helps Luxshare gain exposure to high-end component business, which
carries higher margin than assembly business.
3. Foldable iPhone (iPhone Ultra) exposure: While Luxshare is not the assembler for
the foldable phone, it has actively developed foldable hinge technology, with R&D

focused on high-precision, long-life, large-angle hinge modules for inward-folding
flexible-display devices. The company is also developing ultra-thin haptic motors
tailored for foldable smartphones. When foldable shipments reach a certain scale,

4.  Leading AirPods assembly share:  In the AirPods assembly market, we expect
Luxshare to remain the largest supplier, with GoerTek as the second player. The

iPhone 18 launch is accompanied by new AirPods models, and Luxshare's dominant
AirPods assembly position means that it captures the full breadth of Apple's 2H26
product cycle — not just the iPhone.
Despite a significant FX loss, Luxshare posted resilient earnings in 1H26. We nudge our
EPS estimates up 0.2% each for 2026 and 2027 and 2.0% for 2028 to reflect the solid
1H26 results and positive growth outlook in the following 2-3 years. As a result, we also

raise our H-share price target to HK$82/share, implying 34% upside potential.
Lingyi: Peak season to drive strong earnings improvement
Lingyi  provides a broad range of components, including core precision parts, hinge
precision structural components, screen support plates, flanged ultra-thin stainless steel
battery case modules, etc. Following the launch of iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, and Apple's
first-ever foldable iPhone, Lingyi is likely to benefit from  higher content per unit on

standard Pro models, and a step-change in content value from the foldable iPhone.

AAC: Key beneficiary of  iPhone VC application
AAC Tech is one of Apple's key component suppliers, providing a broad portfolio spanning
acoustics, haptics, and thermal management. The iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max and iPhone Ultra
launch is a direct, multi-dimensional catalyst across all those business segments.
Within the three segments, we believe thermal management –  Vapor Chamber (VC) Heat
Dissipation – is the most important catalyst. AAC Technologies is a key vendor of VC heat

spreaders in the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. The significant expansion of the VC cooling
area is driven by the iPhone 18 Pro's A20 Pro chip, which debuts on a 2nm process node
with complex WMCM packaging technology to support on-device AI computation, leading
to increased thermal output. Apple first introduced VC liquid cooling in the iPhone 17 Pro
series, with AAC as the primary supplier for that generation as well.
This division has already demonstrated significant growth momentum heading into the

iPhone 18 ramp up. In 1H26, heat dissipation revenue surged approximately 400% YoY, to
RMB1.10 billion, primarily driven by the continued ramp-up in shipments of high-
performance innovative vapor chambers. The company expects VC shipments to exceed
180,000k units in 2026, up from 140,000k+  units in 2025.

Combining the strong growth momentum in thermal management, but weaker-than-
expected performance in the optics segment (all supplied to Android), we raise our
earnings estimates  8.4% for 2026 and 6.0% for 2027. After 1H26 results, we believe
investors are aware of the weakness in optics, while the iPhone launch could help re-rate

the stock. We raise our price target to HK$50 – the stronger 19% increase reflects
earnings upgrades and a higher valuation for the thermal-management business – and
maintain our OW rating.
BYDE: Normal peak season, but lackluster with limited spec
upgrade

### Page 12

M
Idea
12
While Apple is BYDE's key customer, accounting for >50% of total revenue, it is mainly
from the  iPad assembly business. Therefore, this division is less likely to benefit from the
iPhone 18 launch.
The company is also the second-largest iPhone metal casing vendor, supplying precision
structural components including titanium and aluminium alloy chassis. While iPhone 18
launch is the direct driver for this segment, the titanium-to-aluminium downgrade has

become a near-term headwind.  Titanium is a higher-value, higher-margin material for BYDE
while aluminium carries lower ASP and lower gross margin. This change has made BYDE
less likely to benefit from the iPhone 18 launch.
Despite the lackluster outlook, we expect earnings to show sequential improvement in
3Q26, driven by the normal peak season in 3Q26, followed by stronger growth in 4Q26 as
liquid cooling products for AI infrastructure also ramp up. Our earnings estimates and

price target remain unchanged.
GoerTek: Margin might face pressures despite peak season
GoerTek's primary Apple exposure is in smart acoustic complete units (AirPods assembly
and components) and precision components. We believe the  iPhone 18 launch and peak
season ramp in 3Q–4Q will drive higher shipment volumes for these products.
However, GoerTek's transfer of production  to Vietnam — where it has invested
approximately US$1.3 billion through multiple entities — has created a persistent labor

cost headwind. In 2H25, a labor shortage caused by the rapid capacity transfer forced
GoerTek to offer higher wages, triggering material  gross margin pressure  for the smart
acoustic assembly business. Overall gross margins partially recovered to 13.8% in 1Q26
and 15.2% in 2Q26, but the underlying trend of rising wages in Vietnam remains a
structural factor. As GoerTek ramps production for the iPhone 18 peak season in 3Q and
4Q, the higher labor cost base in Vietnam will continue to weigh on assembly margins.

We raise our 2026 and 2027 earnings estimates 14.9% and 10.6%, respectively, mainly
reflecting the better-than-expected gross margin recovery in 1H26. However, we raise our
price target only modestly: 4%. to Rmb27, as persistent labor-cost pressure in Vietnam
could limit further margin expansion and reduce the earnings benefit from higher peak-
season volumes.
Considering the factors discussed above, we believe GoerTek is less likely to benefit from

the new iPhone product launch and peak season volume increase.

Where we could be wrong
While we expect iPhone 18 to be  a positive catalyst in 2H26, we are watching three key
variables on the potential inflection points:
1.  Memory prices: These are a key variable this year. If there is a memory price
correction anytime during 2026, investors are likely to expect an earlier
smartphone shipment and margin recovery, which could reverse the negative

sentiment.
2.  LLMs: We see LLMs as a revolutionary innovation. They could introduce numerous
creative features in smartphone applications and change user habits in the years to
come. If the Edge AI breakthrough arrives earlier than we expect, it could
accelerate the smartphone product cycle and make the recovery earlier.
3. iPhone sales performance: Better-than-expected sell-through of the iPhone 18
Pro, Pro Max and its first foldable model could drive shipment upside, higher

content value and stronger capacity utilization. Conversely, weaker demand could
lead to order cuts after the initial ramp up and reduce the earnings benefits from
key hardware upgrades.

Equal-weight (E). The stock's total return is expected to be in line with the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over

Not-Rated (NR). Currently the analyst does not have adequate conviction about the stock's total return relative to the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage

Underweight (U). The stock's total return is expected to be below the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next

EQUITY: TECHNOLOGY
Panjit International   2481.TW 2481 TT
Global Markets Research
11 September 2026
Favorable pricing, product mix to elevate 2H26-2027F profit margins
New AI datacenter orders remain major growth driver
More positive on Panjit’s AI datacenter power MOSFET supply chain position 
Our recent market survey suggests sustained tight supply of select power discrete 
products in 2H26F, such as power/small signal MOSFET, and diodes. Future Electronics’ 
monthly report indicates lengthened lead times for many MOSFET and diode variants in 
Jul/Aug 2026, along with an uptrend in pricing (Fig 5). On the other hand, SDI’s (2351 TT, 
Buy) management indicated that IDM customers are placing more lead frame orders to the 
company with favorable pricing in 2H26E, in order to meet stronger AI-datacenter demand and 
to secure market share. As some products’ lead times have reached historical record levels 
(for e.g., select Schottky/switch diodes and LV/HV MOSFET lead times reached 52 weeks in 
Aug 2026, vs 20 weeks a year ago), and with limited capacity expansion among IDMs/ 
foundries in the near term, we expect the tight supply to continue in 2H26-1H27F. We also 
expect such a benign environment to be a tailwind for vendors to pass-through cost increases. 
We expect Panit’s 2H26-2027F revenue growth and margin expansion to sustain
Panjit’s 2Q26 revenue grew 16% q-q, better than management’s target, and was driven 
by improved demand across end markets. 2Q26 GM reached a 19-quarter high at 33.2% 
on a greater revenue scale, better product mix, and favorable pricing. We expect the 
revenue and profit margin q-q momentum to sustain in 2H26-2027F, as the company has 
secured more orders from the AI datacenter power discrete market, along with price hikes 
(mainly to pass-through rising fab manufacturing and material costs). We expect 3Q26-
4Q26F revenue to grow 10%/5% q-q, with AI datacenter related revenue contributing 12-14% 
total sales (vs 11% in 1H26). We also assume 2H26-2027F GM to reach 36.5%/37.3% (vs 
33.0% in 1H26) with higher AI and automotive sales exposure, better utilization rates across 
manufacturing sites, along with a third round of price hikes in 4Q26F. 
2026F/27F EPS raised by 3%/10%; TP increased to TWD214, implying 38.5% upside
We raise 2026F/27F EPS, as we assume contribution from more new AI datacenter 
orders mainly starting in 2H26-2027F, and expect a more favorable mix and pricing to 
form better margin profiles. Our TP of TWD214 is based on 25x 2027F EPS of TWD8.55 
(previous TP of TWD195 was based on 25x 2027F EPS of TWD7.79). The stock currently 
trades at 18x/16x 2027F/28F EPS.

### Page 3

Company profile
Panjit is a power semiconductor IDM headquartered in Taiwan. It currently manufactures and sells power discrete (including diodes, MOSFET, and
SIC), Power IC, and solar products. The company’s products are widely used in many end applications including industrial, green energy, consumer
electronics, automotive, computers, power supply, and communication.
Valuation Methodology
Our TP of TWD214 is based on 25x 2027F EPS of TWD8.55. We use 25x to derive our TP, vs historical P/E range of 18x since 2018 (The stock

traded in a range from 15-33x when the company was in earnings growth upcycle). The benchmark to the stock is TAIEX.
Risks that may impede the achievement of the target price
Downside risks: 1) global macroeconomic uncertainty that may drag demand for the company's products, especially auto and industrial; 2) slower-
than-expected supply chain inventory destocking; and 3) pricing competition from peers if global demand is worse than expected.
ESG

Panjit requires itself to uphold the business principles of “innovation, growth, responsibility, and sustainability” in the global semiconductor supply
chain in the face of unprecedented changes in the aspects of global environment and climate, economy and society. The company actively
promotes and continues to make improvement in environmental protection, employee safety and health, labor conditions, moral values, and the
maintenance of energy, striving to become a member of the green enterprises in the world while constantly strengthening ESG (the beauty of the

Environment, the goodness in society, and the truthfulness in governance) actions to respond to changes and challenges in the future with a high
level of dynamics.

Definition of Nomura Group's equity research rating system and sectors
The rating system is a relative system, indicating expected performance against a specific benchmark identified for each individual stock, 
subject to limited management discretion. An analyst’s target price is an assessment of the current intrinsic fair value of the stock based on an 
appropriate valuation methodology determined by the analyst. Valuation methodologies include, but are not limited to, discounted cash flow 
analysis, expected return on equity and multiple analysis. Analysts may also indicate expected absolute upside/downside relative to the stated 
target price, defined as (target price - current price)/current price.

SECTORS
A 'Bullish' stance, indicates that the analyst expects the sector to outperform the Benchmark during the next 12 months. A 'Neutral' stance, 
indicates that the analyst expects the sector to perform in line with the Benchmark during the next 12 months. A 'Bearish' stance, indicates that 
the analyst expects the sector to underperform the Benchmark during the next 12 months. Sectors that are labelled as 'Not rated' or shown as 
'N/A' are not assigned ratings. Benchmarks are as follows: United States: S&P 500; Europe: Dow Jones STOXX 600; Global Emerging 
Markets (ex-Asia): MSCI Emerging Markets ex-Asia. Japan/Asia ex-Japan: Sector ratings are not assigned.

Target Price
A Target Price, if discussed, indicates the analyst’s forecast for the share price with a 12-month time horizon, reflecting in part the analyst's 
estimates for the company's earnings. The achievement of any target price may be impeded by general market and macroeconomic trends, and 
by other risks related to the company or the market, and may not occur if the company's earnings differ from estimates.

### Page 1

UMT provides rectangular waveguides, which are conducting pipes with a 
rectangular cross-section used to guide the propagation of microwave or mmwave 
signals. Different shapes and combinations of waveguides can form various RF 
passive components, such as filter / diplexer, coupler, isolator, antenna, power 
amplifiers (PAs), etc. The company serves leading global LEO satellite operators, and 
its waveguides can be seen in LEO satellites / payloads (main), and gateways in 
ground stations.

### Page 2

LEO satellite launches update: Starlink launched 261 LEO satellites in Aug 2026, or 
+13% MoM. The number of satellites per launch continues to increase from 24 satellites 
per launch in May 2026 to 26 satellites per launch in Aug 2026, and at 27 satellites per 
launch so far in Sep 2026, reaffirming our positive view on the constellation construction 
cycle. On Sep 18, SpaceX’s Starship V3 is scheduled to have the 3rd flight and the first 
Starship flight to deploy satellites (a group of Starlink satellites) into stable LEO, and 
should have the 4th flight of Starship V3 within 2026 (link). Starship V3 is a reusable 
vehicle, with LEO capacity at 100k kg, or 339% higher than Falcon 9 Block 5 (22.8kg), the 
current vehicle that Starlink is using. The vehicle migration would not only accelerate 
Starlink’s satellite launches but also release the legacy vehicle (e.g. Falcon 9 Block 5) to 
other LEO satellite operators, facilitating the overall industry’s satellite launches. For 
example, Amazon has planned 10 launches (LF-04 to LF-13) in 2029, using Falcon 9 
Block 5. Assuming 27 satellites per launch via the vehicle, the 10 missions would bring 
270 satellites (vs. 180 / 216 satellites in 2025 / 7M26 that Amazon added). Amazon is 
also increasing its satellites per launch: the upcoming pipeline shows 35-48 satellites per 
launch vs. 29-36 satellites per launch in May to July 2026, or increasing by 28% on avg. 
The acceleration of LEO satellite launches reaffirms our positive view on UMT.

Earnings revision: We factor in Aug revenues, and raise net income by 1% in 2026-28E. 
The revenue raise is to reflect our positive view on accelerating LEO satellite launches 
along with specification upgrade driving up the dollar content. Our GM is reduced to 
reflect our expectation that the larger scale would lead to lower GM with customers’ 
rising procurement power. Nevertheless, with the company’s product mix upgrade 
toward LEO satellite, the blended GM should continue to increase through 2028E.

### Page 4

Valuation: We continue to derive our target price based on a discounted P/E, and based 
on 2029E (methodology unchanged). We continue to derive the target P/E multiple from 
the average PEG&M ratio of peers in the satellite supply chain, and we remove outliers 
(those below 0.3x, which are mostly telecom operators who face competition from LEO 
satellite operators or having consumer electronics exposure which suffered from high 
memory costs). Our target 2029E discounted P/E multiple is at 37.0x (unchanged) which 
is based on peers’ avg. PEG&M, and UMT’s 2029-30E avg. NI YoY and OPM. We apply the 
37.0x multiple to 2029E EPS and discount it back to 2027E via a COE of 7.8% (no 
change). Our target price is at NT$2,557 (vs. NT$2,513 previously), implying 61x 2027E 
P/E, which is above the company’s average +1 stv. P/E of 42x, reflecting our positive view 
on UMT’s product mix upgrade toward LEO satellites. Maintain Buy.

Price target risks and methodology - UMT 
Valuation: We use a discounted P/E methodology and apply a 37.0x target P/E multiple 
to UMT’s 2029E EPS, discounting it back to 2027E at a COE of 7.8% (beta 1.2x, risk-free 
rate 1.6% and market risk premium at 5.1%), which leads to our 12-month target price 
of NT$2,557. The target P/E is based on the average PEG&M ratio of peers in the 
satellite supply chain. We are Buy-rated on UMT.  
Key Risks: Slower-than-expected LEO satellite deployment; Potential competition from 
new-entrant suppliers; LEO satellite operators manufacturing in-house components.

Industry View In-Line
We keep our 3Q26 iPhone build estimate unchanged at 54M units (+4% q/q, -2%
y/y). The slower y/y run rate reflects new model SKUs shifting to the premium
segment (18 Pro/Pro Max and iPhone Fold), while the iPhone 18 model is scheduled

for introduction in 1H27. We introduce our 4Q26 iPhone build estimate at 73M
units (+35% q/q, -4% y/y). Total new iPhone 18 model family units reached 71M
units (-21% y/y) in 2H26, with one less SKU launched compared to last year. We
expect 7M units of iPhone Duo builds in 2H26. A starting price of US$1,999 (relative
to expectations of US$2,300 or higher) appears favorable to builds, but there are
likely still some production issues that the supply chain is working on. This is why

the iPhone Duo is available to  the market only one month later, and we will
continue to monitor ramp-up progress for any upside or downside to builds. Our full
year iPhone build estimate is 235M units (+3% y/y).
Our 3Q26 iPad build forecast is unchanged at 12M units (-8% q/q, -14% y/y). We
attribute the 3Q sequential decline to some pull-forward demand in 1H and the
impact of rising prices. We introduce our 4Q iPad build forecast at 11M units (-8%

q/q, -21% y/y). Our full year iPad build estimate is 46.1M units (-15% y/y).

Analyst Stock Ratings
Overweight (O). The stock's total return is expected to exceed the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next
12-18 months.
Equal-weight (E). The stock's total return is expected to be in line with the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over

the next 12-18 months.
Not-Rated (NR). Currently the analyst does not have adequate conviction about the stock's total return relative to the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage
universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next 12-18 months.
Underweight (U). The stock's total return is expected to be below the average total return of the analyst's industry (or industry team's) coverage universe, on a risk-adjusted basis, over the next

12-18 months.
Unless otherwise specified, the time frame for price targets included in Morgan Stanley Research is 12 to 18 months.
Analyst Industry Views
Attractive (A): The analyst expects the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months to be attractive vs. the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated
below.
In-Line (I): The analyst expects the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months to be in line with the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated below.

Cautious (C): The analyst views the performance of his or her industry coverage universe over the next 12-18 months with caution vs. the relevant broad market benchmark, as indicated below.

Global Research
First Read
Novatek Microelectronics Corp.
2026 Taiwan Summit: PC weakness offset by
continued momentum from major U.S. customer
Q3 revenue still expected to grow 5-6% QoQ despite weaker notebook demand
Novatek attended our 2026 Taiwan Summit on Sep 14th. It reiterates Q326 revenue to
grow  5-6% QoQ, supported by seasonal strength in S/M-sized DDI driven by the iPhone
ramp. SoC revenue is expected to grow slightly QoQ, while LDDI should decline

modestly as TV demand remains flattish and PC demand weakens. Importantly,
management highlights notebook PC has seen a meaningful downward adjustment
recently. While the company had originally expected NB shipments to decline  slightly
QoQ, demand has deteriorated to over 10% decline QoQ, with the impact becoming
visible since mid-August. Nevertheless, Q326F guidance for TV, tablet and automotive
remains unchanged. Looking into Q426, management expects seasonal weakness to

continue, with softer memory-driven ASP increases and lower shipment volume likely
resulting in sequential revenue decline.
GM likely peaked in Q226 and should normalize into H226 and 2027
Management highlighted that Q226 GM expanded to 42% from 39% in Q126, mainly
driven by  favourable product mix and lower-cost of  inventory for memory. Looking
ahead, GM is expected to decline QoQ in Q326F as the inventory benefit disappears and
growth shifts toward S/M-sized DDI and LDDI, which carry lower margins than SoC.

Management expects Q426 GM to further contract QoQ, driven by less favourable mix
and softer memory-driven ASP increases. Further out, memory, foundry and OSAT costs
are expected to continue rising into 2027. While Novatek expects to pass through most
cost increases, management acknowledged that the degree and timing of pass-through
will depend on the  negotiation with its customers.
Major US customer remains the key growth driver for 2027-28
The company reiterated strong visibility from its major U.S. customer and expects

revenue to further grow in 2027. Following entry into iPhone DDI programs in 2024 and
subsequent share gains in 2025-26, Novatek expects to continue benefiting from rising
market share as new iPhone models proliferate. Into 2027-28F,  iPhone-related growth
should moderate as the revenue base becomes larger, while management expects
increasing contribution from  premium LCD panels for Macs, supported by a more visible
roadmap. Beyond the U.S. customer, image SoC remains a bright spot due to strong

surveillance demand and emerging Edge AI applications, although management
acknowledged recent growth rates are unlikely to be sustained.
Valuation: Maintain NEUTRAL with price target of NT$540
We retain NEUTRAL with PT of NT$540. While we continue to expect GM normalization
in H226E and 2027E, we believe its GM should sustain at the high-30% level, rather
than  returning to pre-COVID's low-30%.

Company Description
Novatek is a IC design company spun off from UMC's commercial product division in 1997.
The company is focusing on the analog and mixed signal IC design and leads in the display
driver IC and TV SoC market.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement
We value Novatek using a PE methodology.

Upside risks include stronger-than-expected demand for the consumer electronics end-
market, as well as higher market share for OLED DDI.
Downside risks include a weaker-than-expected technology end-market demand recovery
and slower-than-expected inventory digestion.

of the capacity in T aiwan is allocated to AMD, which it will start from the  game-console

products and then target to enter server CPU. For the Broadcom business, PTI has
previously announced a JV with Broadcom in Singapore, where it will invest US$400mn
into the JV for 30% stake, after receiving regulatory approvals in Q426. The JV will focus
on Broadcom's next generation networking products and will help it to enter into optical
communication field.  It has not disclosed the total investment amount and planned
capacity for the Singapore JV fab, but we believe the planned capacity  could be 2-3x

versus its scale in T aiwan. The JV is expected to start mass production from 2028 and PTI
will be in charged of the fab operations. Nevertheless, PTI also acknowledges that
TSMC's CoPoS will not only lead to potential competition, but could  also have some
impact on the equipment supply schedule.
Memory-backed price hike should continue
PTI's August sales of NT$8,558mn was up 3.5% MoM and 24.5% YoY. QTD sales is
tracking to 69%/68% of UBSe/Street estimates of +5%/+6% QoQ. Management noted

its  back-end loading is already at 90% and it has been selective on customer programs
for better ASP products. Management also expects back-end ASP should continue to
increase, driven primarily by higher labor costs and rising component prices. At the same
time, the pressure to lower its ASPs and  share the profit from yield improvement has
eased. Relative to peers, PTI noted it has been less aggressive in implementing price
increases, but has increased the frequency of price negotiation with its customer. As a

result, its gross margin for  memory packaging and test should continue to trend higher
in the coming quarters.
Capex will remain elevated in 2026-27F
Management reiterate its 2026F capex guidance of NT$50bn and believes its capex in
2027F will remain elevated. It aims to use its internal cash flow and bank loans to
support the capex, and remains committed to keep its  dividend payout at ~60%. Full
year  revenue for 2026F is likely to surpass its prior peak in 2022 (i.e. NT$83.9bn),

although it believes  market expectation of NT$100bn in 2026E could be too stretched.
Valuation: Retain NEUTRAL with PT of NT$260
We retain NEUTRAL on PTI with PT of NT$260, based on 17x 2027 PE. We will continue
to monitor its progress on FOPLP/CPO and price improvement sustainability.

板（ PCB ）事 業 部 後 逐 步 轉 型 為 專 業 PCB 製 造 廠 。 主 要 產 品 為 雙 面 板 與 多 層

【 前 次 投 資 建 議 】區 間 操 作，1,260 
【大盤指數/股價】47106 / 1340

➢ 2H26 新品逐步放量，營運動能增溫  
雙鴻 8 月營收 31.4 億元，MoM-16.6%，YoY+67.2%， 營收月減是受客
戶拉貨排程影響，以及 7 月基期較高所致。雙鴻 1H26 伺服器營收占比
已突破 70%(水冷營收占比已達 55%)，3Q26 為新舊產品交替期，整體
2H26 在 ASIC 與 GPU 伺服器的強勢帶動下，營運展望樂觀，公司維持
全年營收 YoY+70%的目標不變： 
1)隨著搭載新一代晶片的 AISC 伺服器問世，ASIC 散熱方案預期會在
4Q26~1Q27 明顯推升雙鴻業績 ， 且ASIC 客戶持續擴大水冷散熱導入 ，
此部分效益可挹注到 2027 年；2)雙鴻 3Q26 cold plate 出貨以 GB300
為大宗 ， 近期宣布其Vera Rubin cold plate， 已回到NVIDIA 推薦名單 ，
預期 4Q26 小量出貨；3)其他新品方面，DIMM cold plate 已於 2Q26
小量出貨。CPU 均熱片 2026 年營收占比為個位數，要到 2027~2028
年效益才會較明顯。 
➢ 2027 年泰國持續擴產 
雙鴻生產基地位於台灣、中國(廣州/昆山/重慶/合肥)、泰國，泰國廠為
近年擴產重點 ：1)泰國一期廠區已於 2025 年投產 ， 主要生產cold plate、
manifold、Rack CDU 等液冷散熱元件，目前產能為 cold plate 250k/
月、manifold 3k/ 月；2)泰國二期於 2026 年 9 月正式量產，主要生產
cold plate 、manifold，並預留電源水冷產能，若各產品線產能順利拉
升 ， 未來泰國各項產品產能可翻倍 ；3)泰國三期規劃在 4Q26 動工 、2H27
投產；4)泰國四期預計 2028 年動工。 
➢ 建議調升至買進，目標價 1,620 元  
雙鴻 2H26 營運展望正向，AI 伺服器的強勢增長，能彌補消費性電子市
況低迷帶來的不利影響。 3Q26 GB 300 散熱產品出貨持續增量，並且
cold plate 已重新回到 NVIDIA Vera Rubin 推薦名單，預期 4Q26 小量
出貨，而 ASIC 客戶之新品亦逐漸放量中，有利營運回溫。雙鴻歷史 PE
區間為 8X~36X， 考量新品可逐步帶動2H26~1H27 之業績 ， 且目前PE
評價偏低，建議逢低買進，目標價 1,620 元(2027F PE 20X)。

1H26 伺服器營收占比已突破 70%(水冷營收占比已達 55%)，3Q26 為新舊產品交替
期，整體 2H26 在 ASIC 與 GPU 伺服器的強勢帶動下，營運展望樂觀，公司維持全年
營收 YoY+70%的目標不變： 
1)隨著搭載新一代晶片的 AISC 伺服器問世 ，ASIC 散熱方案預期會在 4Q26~1Q27 明
顯推升雙鴻業績，且 ASIC 客戶持續擴大水冷散熱導入，此部分效益可挹注到 2027
年。雙鴻估計 2026 年底 ASIC 客戶將占單月營收達 40%，2027 年 ASIC 營收占比將
擴增至 50%；2)雙鴻 3Q26 cold plate 出貨以 GB300 為大宗 ， 近期宣布其Vera Rubin

涵蓋 cold plate 、Rack Manifold 、Inner Manifold 的完整方案；3)其他新品方面，
DIMM cold plate 已於 2Q26 小量出貨。CPU 均熱片(Heat Spreader)2026 年營收占
比為個位數，要到 2027 年~2028 年效益才會較明顯。 
投研部預期，在新舊平台完成交接，新品順利放量的情境下，雙鴻伺服器營收占比將
上升至 80%以上，受惠新品效應與水冷的導入，可帶動毛利率回升，投研部預估雙鴻
3Q26 營收 101.9 億元，QoQ+17.2%，YoY+71.1%，毛利率 29.8%，EPS 達 15.40
元。

2027 年泰國持續擴產   
雙鴻生產基地位於台灣、中國(廣州/昆山/重慶/合肥)、泰國， 泰國廠為近年擴產重點 。
各廠區規劃如下 ：1)泰國一期廠區已於 2025 年投產 ， 主要生產cold plate、manifold、
Rack CDU 等液冷散熱元件，目前產能為 cold plate 250k/月、manifold 3k/月；2)泰
國二期於 2026 年 9 月正式量產，主要生產 cold plate、manifold，並預留電源水冷
產能，若各產品線產能順利拉升，未來泰國各項產品產能可翻倍； 3)泰國三期規劃在
4Q26 動工、2H27 投產；4)泰國四期預計 2028 年動工；5)中國廠區負責生產筆電、
高階顯示卡 、 伺服器散熱相關產品 ， 整體上 ， 以氣冷模組較多 ， 也有少量的cold plate、
manifold；6)台灣主力生產 CDU (Cooling Distribution Unit)，並負責高階與高精度
液冷產品的研發和樣品試產。

設備訂單供不應求，訂單能見度長達 9~12 月 
展望 3Q26 隨 AI/先進製程/封裝/記憶體投資帶動設備需求強勁，整體營收估
計 YoY>QoQ，其中製造服務 YoY、QoQ 皆為成長，維修受先進製程高稼動
率支撐，惟富蘭登受到上季認列航太專案高基期影響，預估 QoQ 下滑、
YoY 仍呈成長。自主開發受到升級改版產品導入先進製程，預估  QoQ、
YoY 皆為成長。因此，預估 3Q26 營收季增 5%、毛利率受到春武里廠稼動
率提升、檢測業務因客戶部份帶料而預期有所改善，費用率持平、推估 EPS 
6.32 元。目前訂單能見度至 9~12 個月，部份品項可看到 27 年底，預期營
收逐季往上，2026~27 年營收維持新高格局。 
看好檢測代工量能，毛利率亦有機會逐步改善 
2Q26 營收結構為半導體設備代工 85%、維修服務 14%、自主開發設備 1%，
其中來自設備代工分別季增 11%/年增 14%，隨先進製程推進及晶片結構複
雜度提升，帶動蝕刻、薄膜沉積與檢測等關鍵設備需求，以上三者營收佔比
>5 成。Repair 季增 37%/年增 125%，除了晶圓廠 UTR 維持高檔，主要成
長來自富蘭登 6 月認列航太專案。檢測設備營收年增 6 倍/佔比提升至 14%。
持續看好檢測代工動能，基於先進製程複雜度提升帶動高精度量測與檢測需
求增加，預估 2026~27 年檢測業務數量機會倍增，毛利率可望在 2H26 交易
模式改客戶自備高價料件，雖然造成營收貢獻減少，但有助毛利率提升。 
AI 帶動先進製程/HBM 需求強勁，新增泰國二期擴產計劃 
根據 SEMI 預估 2026 年 WFE 市場規模年增 23%，主要由 AI 帶動先進製程
需求，並已獲得客戶更長訂單需求，預計產能將為目前泰國廠一倍，預計
2H27 陸續投產。展望 2026~27 年動能來自 AI/HBM/先進製程設備需求維持
高檔，檢測設備代工、富蘭登營收貢獻擴大等。本中心預估 2026/27 年
EPS 21.83/27.44 元，分別下修 5%/上修 5%，主要基於訂單需求強勁及新
增二期擴產，主要受新廠費用、檢測毛利率波動而調整假設基礎。 
元大觀點

⧫  
展望 2026/27 年主力客戶展望佳/公司供應比提升及檢測、富蘭登訂單
需求強勁，搭配泰國擴產，營運可望優於產業平均。

抑獲利成長空間，亦使評價有所調整。

產業概況  
先進製程與供應鏈在地化為大勢所趨 
自疫情後各國積極推動半導體供應鏈在地化，美國、歐洲、日本相繼祭出補貼以吸引先進製程及先
進封裝投資，使全球新廠與擴產計畫明顯增加，帶動設備與廠務族群自  2023 年起營收與市值持續
成長。 展望 2026 年，本中心預期設備與廠務族群仍將延續成長趨勢，主因包含 1)  AI 、HPC 需求
持續快速成長、先進製程產能加速放量 ; 2) 主要半導體製造商資本支出擴增、台積電美國建廠將於
2026 年加速，WFE (Wafer Fab Equipment) 將成長 9%。預估 2026 年主要晶圓廠資本支出達
1,792 億美元(YoY+37%)，其中台積電及海力士之資本支出年增分別為 51%/19%，美光同時也年
增 50%，反映 AI 帶動先進製程/HBM 相關設備需求強勁，將進一步推動廠務與設備需求加速成長。

2026~2027 年半導體設備支出持續創新高 
根據 SEMI 預估 2026/2027 年 WFE 成長 9/7%，其中 Memory 主要受到記憶體廠稼動率回升及 AI
帶動 HBM 需求強勁，Logic 除了 AI 相關投資以外，多數仍在消耗先前過剩產能為主，展望 2026
年景氣全面復甦、AI 持續擴大、新建廠效應，WFE 將進一步成長 9%，反映 AI 帶動先進製程/HBM
相關設備需求強勁，成熟製程方面，台積電也於 2026/7/16 表示海外成熟製程中以 PMIC 與 CMOS
需求較強，顯示未來成熟製程也仍有溫和成長的趨勢。

2026 年半導體設備銷售延續復甦力道 隨著晶圓代工成長 
2026 年全球半導體設備總銷售額成長 16.2%達 1,450 億美元，預估 2027 年成長 7.6%，連續三年
創新高。預估晶圓廠設備銷售將於 2026/2027 年分別年成長 17.1%/7.7%，主要成長來自 AI 帶動
先進製程、HBM 需求強勁。 
觀察過去歷史循環，半導體設備營收年增率與晶圓代工廠營收年增率連動性高，且落後晶圓代工廠
約 2~3 季回升，並且半導體設備股價表現則與營收年增率呈現高度連動。

### Page 6

請參閱末頁之免責宣言。 台灣：半導體設備與耗材 2026 年 9 月 11 日 Foxsemicon 第6 頁，共 13頁  
獲利調整與股票評價  
維持買進評等、目標價降至 350 元 
元大最新預估京鼎 2026/27 年 EPS 分別為 21.83 /27.44 元，分別下修 5%/上修 5%，儘管公司來
自 AI 與 HPC 持續擴張，帶動先進邏輯、記憶體與先進封裝投資，設備訂單需求維持強勁，且動能
將延續至 2027 年。惟毛利率受到產品組合、泰國新廠初期營運成本影響，較預期低 0.5~1 個百分
點。目前訂單能見度長達 9~12 個月，部份訂單甚至到 27 年底。預估 3Q26 營收 QoQ、YoY 皆為
正成長，後續營收逐季攀升，2026 年營運表現可望優於 WFE 產業平均水準。2026 年營收主要假
設，雖然產業成長約 19~25% ，但部份設備拉貨 已提前至 2025 年 反應 ( 公司 25 年營收
YoY+26%>WFE YoY+ 12%)，26 年主要動能來自檢測新代工訂單、富蘭登完整年度營收貢獻，加
上泰國春武里 3Q26 投產，估計營收成長 21%，優於產業平均成長，毛利率估計較 25 年下滑 2 個
百分點，主要檢測設備業務為整機代工，毛利率偏低，另外，春武 里廠折舊估計加 1.6 億元及其他
初期營運成本等。27 年營收 YoY 成長由 7%提升至 15%，主要 2H27 新增泰國二期部份產能貢獻，
毛利率預期在檢測交易模式改變，估計較 26 年有所改善。根據 2026/27 年預估獲利換算本益比為
13/10 倍，落於歷史區間 7-15 倍的中下緣，略低於國內同業平均本益比約 18-22 倍、低於國外同業
30-45 倍。看好 2026~27 年營運持續創新高、中長期來自先進製程邏輯相關設備需求強勁及各國政
策建立自主供應鏈為重要動能。維持買進評等，惟短期股價反映毛利率低於預期而使評價面受影響，
因而目標本益比由 15 倍降至 13 倍， 2027 年 EPS 27.44 元，推得目標價 350 元。

公司簡介  
京鼎成立於 2001 年，專注於半導體、自動化及微污染防治設備之製造及銷售，前段晶圓製造以生產製程及檢測設備為主，
包含有化學機械研磨 (CMP)、薄膜沉積(PVD/CVD/ALD)、蝕刻(Etching)等設備製造，而備件則以真空製程元件及其他精密
機構件為主，包含濺鍍瞄準器、氣體整流器、CMP 研磨頭等。京鼎於 2002 年通過 AMAT 半導體設備製造商之合格供應商
認證，目前 AMAT 佔占公司營收約 8 成，其中京鼎在 CVD/Etch 代工營收佔比超過 5 成。

ESG 分析  
分別藉由「在 ESG 議題上的曝險」和「個別公司在 ESG 議題上的執行力」兩個面向來衡量公司於 ESG 上的表現。 
► ESG 總分： 京鼎整體的 ESG 風險評級屬於低風險，於 Sustainalytics 資料庫所覆蓋的公司中排名亦排行於靠前的位置，
但在設備代工行業中的公司中排名優於同業。 
► 在 ESG 議題上的曝險： 京鼎的整體曝險屬於低等水準，約等同於半導體設備行業的平均水準。公司較需要改善的 ESG 
議題包含人力資本、商業道德及資源使用等。 
► 個別公司在 ESG 議題上的執行力：京鼎在針對重大 ESG 議題的管理水準和執行力屬中等。京鼎於 ESG 相關揭露程度
高，顯示其對投資人及大眾的責任感極佳，雖說公司有針對重大 ESG 議題進行管控，但對於關鍵領域仍缺乏相關政策
及計畫。然而，目前京鼎尚未涉及任何 ESG 重大爭議。

材、評價資訊以及風險概況之分析。建議投資人於投資部位中增持該股。 
持有-超越同業：本中心認為根據目前股價，該檔個股基本面吸引力高於 同業。此一觀點係基於本中心對該股發展前景、財務表現、利多題材、評價資訊
以及風險概況之分析。 
持有-落後同業：本中心認為根據目前股價，該檔個股基本面吸引力低於 同業。此一觀點係基於本中心對該股發展前景、財務表現、利多題材、評價資訊
以及風險概況之分析。

材、評價資訊以及風險概況之分析。建議投資人於投資部位中減持該股。 
評估中：本中心之預估、評等、目標價尚在評估中，但仍積極追蹤該個股。 
限制評等：為遵循相關法令規章及/或元大之政策，暫不給予評等及目標價。

再給我兩季度，讓泰國的產線轉盈

永豐觀點 
管理層預期 2026 年獲利低點在 2Q26，而我們對未來毛利率的改善速度存疑，係
因泰國二期擴產將持續壓抑獲利，認為 1 年內要回到過往 25-28%的結構性毛利
率區間仍有挑戰，並持續影響股價評價。 
 投資評價與建議 
目標價降至 347 元：京鼎能見度 9 個月以上，需求強度前所未見，但我們認為管
理層需透過毛利率的提升證明公司價值和競爭力，而不是客戶說擴就擴、說走就
走。預估 2026/2027 年 EPS 20.7/26.7 元，目前 PER 約 10.5x 在近年 8-17x 區間
中下緣，維持買進但對公司獲利改善速度存疑，故將目標價由 420 元(15x 2027 
EPSF)修至 347 元(13x 2027 EPSF)。

ESG 評析 
京鼎企業永續評鑑整體為 B+等，於 SASB 產業永續議題與跨產業五大永續面向平
均得分分別為 B+等與 B+等。

京鼎為半導體設備和系統整合廠：京鼎成立於 2001 年，為鴻海集團旗下之半導體
設備及系統整合公司，亦為國際大廠應用材料(AMAT US)之設備代工廠，目前主要
從事半導體、能源及面板設備製造服務及自主開發業務，員工人數4,524 人，目前
資本額 11.08 億新台幣。2Q26 營收依業務比重為：製造服務 85%、維修服務(半
導體零組件系統維修、CMP 研磨頭、富蘭登) 14%、自主開發(應用於晶圓製造、
先進封裝的非製程設備) 2%。生產據點位於台灣竹南和江蘇昆山、上海松江、美國
矽谷(NPI 廠)、 泰國羅勇廠 、 泰國春武里廠(3Q26 量產)。 主要客戶為應用材料(AMAT 
US)，2025 年佔營收約 84.8%。 
2Q26 毛利率為全年谷底：京鼎 2Q26 營收 63.0 億(+13.3%QoQ，+21.1%YoY)，
其中製造服務營收 53.6 億(+11.2%QoQ)受惠客戶對蝕刻、沉積、檢測等設備需求
成長、維修服務業務 8.8 億(+37.2%QoQ)主因為富蘭登航太專案營收貢獻，自主
開發營收 0.55 億(-43.6%QoQ)則受到微污染防治設備改版影響，毛利率22.3%為
2H19 以來新低，稅後淨利 4.7 億(+8.0%QoQ，+38.6%YoY)，EPS 4.61 元。獲利
表現低於預期主因(1) 毛利率因泰國春武里廠 2Q26 仍在量產初期 、 產品組合轉差
(檢測業務營收占比由 1Q26 的 12%提升至 14%)而低於預期，(2) 業外有匯兌損
失影響約 1.4 億。 
最壞狀況已過，毛利率回穩：管理層預期 3Q26 營運將維持逐季成長態勢，其中製
造服務受惠下游客戶對設備需求增加而成長 、 自主開發的微污染防治設備則隨客戶
完成驗收後有顯著成長、維修服務則因少了 6 月份認列的航太專案而下滑，更重
要的是，隨著檢測設備交易模式調整(部分關鍵料件改為客戶 Consign)，以及春武
里廠量產後規模效應放大，毛利率將開始改善。研究部預估京鼎 3Q26 營收 67.5
億(+7.2%QoQ，+21.9%YoY)，毛利率 22.9%，稅後淨利 6.1 億(+20.3%QoQ，-
7.9%YoY)，EPS 5.54 元。 
泰國廠啟動二期擴產：為因應客戶對 2028 年的產能需求，京鼎在8 月初通過泰國
子公司二期資本支出預算共 2.34 億美元，並於 2H26 開始進行土建發包與採購。
隨著一期設備陸續移入，預期泰國廠佔集團總產能比例將由目前的 15%，提升至
4Q26/2Q27 的 20%/25%，二期的設備則從 2H27 開始移入，將既有廠房空間填
滿且不需重新驗證，長期泰國廠 (羅勇及春武里合計 )將佔京鼎製造服務產能的
50%，成為台灣以外的第二大基地。獲利狀況上，羅勇廠在 2-3Q26 開始貢獻獲
利、春武里廠轉盈時點則落在 4Q26，且隨費用控制改案，營業費用率將落在

求大幅成長，京鼎目前能見度已達 9 個月以上，目前正在與客戶洽談 2027-2029
年需求，且泰國一期獲利改善進度順利，2027 年將不拖累獲利。研究部認為2026
年在客戶預先儲備庫存之下，營收成長性或與 WFE 產業相當，2027 年則有望隨
春武里廠產能開出，營收可維持雙位數成長， 惟公司仍未明說供應鏈彈性的價值是
否可反映給客戶， 且獲利改善狀況仍待時間驗證，故我們認為公司評價短期仍將受
壓抑。

29.6 億(+29.0%YoY)，EPS 26.69 元(原估 27.98 元，下修主要考量公司持續擴產
影響獲利改善速度，同時對業外假設較為保守)。

2Q26 高階產品持續放量，毛利率季增 1.5 個百分點 
臻鼎 2Q26 營收 484.3 億元，季增 18.9%、年增 26.8%，主要受惠 AI 伺服
器、光模組及 IC 載板等高階產品快速放量，三大高階應用 (伺服器、光模組
及 IC 載板) 營收占比由 1Q26 的 19.7%提升至 23.2%，1H26 相關營收年增
113%。受惠產品組合改善及逐步向客戶反映原物料成本，2Q26 毛利率提升
至 23.1%，季增 1.5ppts/年增 4.7ppts；儘管研發及新產能前置費用增加，
營業利益仍達 37.6 億元，季增 50.2%、年增 55.1%。業外受惠金融資產評
價利益 14.8 億元、政府補助及利息收入挹注，部分抵銷匯兌損失 6.7 億元，
稅後純益 23.9 億元，季增 67.8%、年增 295%，EPS 2.16 元。 
3Q26 進入傳統旺季，4Q26 高階產品貢獻進一步放大 
展望 3Q26 將進入傳統旺季，各產品線將陸續放量，載板、AI 伺服器等高毛
利產品出貨持續提升， AI 手機及折疊機亦受惠設計複雜度增加，帶動單機
PCB 價值量成長；此外，淮安新 HDI 園區將陸續裝機，預期 4Q26 起貢獻
逐步放大。本中心預估 3Q/4Q26 營收 603/685.6 億元，季增 24.5%/13.7%，
毛利率提升至 24%/25.9%；營業利益 54.1/73.8 億元，季增 43.8%/36.4%，
稅後純益 34.1/50 億元，季增 42.4%/47%，EPS  3.07/4.51 元。 
新增高階產能於 2027 年放量，維持買進評等，目標價 680 元 
臻鼎新增產能將於 2026－2030 年間分階段開出。其中，淮安及泰國高階
PCB 新產能預計自 4Q26 起陸續試產，並於 2027 年進一步放量，有助提升
供給能力。本中心預估 2026/2027 年伺服器、光模組及 IC 載板合計營收占
比將達 23%/37%，相關營收年增 119%/121%，帶動整體毛利率提升至
23.9%/28.7%，EPS 為 11.07/27.33 元。另外，現有業務及載板方面將陸續
調整價格，長期而言臻鼎積極轉型且擴產進度也超越同業。考量高階產品占
比提升及新產能進入收穫期，維持臻鼎買進評等，給予本益比 25 倍，並以
2027 年 EPS 推得目標價 680 元。

升至 23.1%，營業利益年增 55.1%，本業獲利持續改善。

提升至 24%/25.9%，高毛利產品出貨增加將推升獲利逐季成長。

進評等，目標價 680 元，以 2027 EPS 27.33 元及 25 倍本益比評估。

全球高階產能加速開出，2026-27 年營運成長動能可望持續放大 
臻鼎持續加速大陸及泰國高階 PCB 產能布局，目前共有 13 棟新廠建設中、16 棟新廠規劃中，新
增產能將依客戶導入及量產進度於 2026-2030 年間分階段開出；所有擴產均以北美一線 CSP、晶
片廠及其他核心客戶的中長期技術與產能綁定為基礎，部分高階專案合作能見度已延伸至 2029 年。 
其中淮安 HA、HB、HC 園區預計於 2026 年底前完成 6 棟高階 PCB 新廠，HD 園區則規劃生產
iHDI／mSAP 及 HLC 產品，已於 8 月完成主體封頂，預計 3M27 加入生產、2Q27 進入量產，全部
建置完成後將成為全球最大的 PCB 生產基地；深圳第三園區智慧製造基地已於 7M26 動土，規劃
興建 3 棟智慧製造廠房，主要生產 AI 伺服器及光模組用高階類載板，以及 AI 終端用高階軟板。海
外方面，泰國 PA01 主要生產高階 iHDI、HLC 及光模組產品，3Q25 進入量產後爬坡順利，已通過
多家客戶認證並於 7M26 達損益兩平，目前另有 3 棟新廠及 1 棟機械鑽孔中心同步建置，預計
2026 年底前陸續完成裝機，自 4Q26 起逐步進入試產。 本中心認為隨 4Q26 起新產能陸續進入試
產、2027 年淮安及泰國新增產能進一步放量，臻鼎高階 AI 伺服器、光模組及高階 PCB 供給能力
將明顯提升，搭配新廠稼動率爬升及產品組合持續往高附加價值產品移動，有利 2026-27 年營運規
模與獲利能力持續成長。

2026/2027 年光模塊、HDI、載板業務為臻鼎營運體質改善重點 
展望 2026/2027 年，隨 AI 伺服器、高速光通訊、IC 載板及高階 PCB 需求快速成長，臻鼎正啟動
新一輪大規模擴產計畫，且擴產方向將以高階 AI 伺服器、光模組及載板等，預期臻鼎的產品組合
將迎來結構性翻轉。IC 載板與高階 HDI (含 mSAP/iHDI) 將成為最核心的獲利驅動產品： 
1) 伺服器產品方面，隨著  AI 晶片運算架構與功耗提升，伺服器系統對於訊號完整度（ Signal 
Integrity）與低傳輸損耗的要求持續提升。傳統高多層板若單純仰賴堆疊層數，將受限於厚通孔與
殘樁干擾，訊號耗損難以滿足每秒、每瓦 Token 處理效率的嚴苛指標。因此 AI 伺服器主板、加速
運算卡（OAM / Compute Board ）及交換板已見陸續導入高階 HDI、AnyLayer HDI 以及厚板混層
設計（Thick Board HDI ），目前臻鼎為美系 GPU 及 ASIC HDI 供應商，預期隨產能開出將放大營
收貢獻。

2)載板方面，預期 AI GPU 與 AI ASIC 仍為載板廠商 2026 年最主要的成長動能。隨著 AI 相關與高
階高速傳輸晶片需求提升，所使用之 ABF 載板規格亦明顯升級，朝向高層數與大尺寸發展。以規
格來看，傳統 PC CPU 所使用之 ABF 載板尺寸約為 37.5 × 37.5 mm ，層數約 8–10 層；而新一代
AI GPU 載板尺寸已提升至 55 × 55 mm 或 58 × 58 mm ，層數多落在 12 層，甚至進一步放大至 75 
× 75 mm 以上。此外，載板尺寸與層數通常為影響報價的關鍵因素，且隨著高階應用需求持續浮現，
製程難度呈現非線性上升，使高階載板報價漲幅往往高於尺寸與層數的成長幅度。

3)光模組方面，臻鼎積極布局高速光通訊市場，並已建立涵蓋 NPO、XPO 及 CPO 等應用的光模
組 PCB 與類載板（SLP／mSAP）產品線。且就日前於 Semicon 展示產品來看，NPO 模組板已採
用 12 層（5+2+5）、板厚 1.0 mm ，搭配埋孔設計及 L/S 25/30µm 精細線路；XPO 超高密度可插
拔模組則進一步提升至 14 層（6+2+6）、板厚 1.2 mm ，對應 12.8T 規格，除採用 mSAP 及埋孔
製程外，亦導入 L1–L5 及 L14–L7 階梯式 Cavity 挖槽，使模組體積較傳統 OSFP 縮小約 75%，單
位面積密度提升約 4 倍，整體朝更高規格演進。在 CPO／NPO 交換機方面，臻鼎亦已 布局針對
1.6T、3.2T 至 6.4T 光模組之解決方案。隨 CPO／NPO 架構逐步發展，光電元件與交換 ASIC 之
間距離持續縮短，PCB 線寬／線距、層間對位、Cavity、阻抗控制及尺寸穩定度等要求亦將同步提
高，有利具備高階 HDI 及 mSAP 量產能力之 PCB 廠商提升產品價值量。

產業概況  
光收發模組將於 800G 及 1.6T 高速成長且再向更高速邁進，光傳輸元件需求爆增 
光收發模組(Optical Transceiver) 是資料中心、5G 網路與光纖通信中的關鍵元件，負責將電訊號轉
為光訊號(發射)，以及將光訊號轉為電訊號 (接收)，以實現高速、長距離的數據傳輸。 AI 叢集規模
持續擴大，帶動高速交換器及光模組用量快速成長，每顆光模組約搭配一片 PCB，使光模組出貨
量可直接轉化為 PCB 需求。2026-2027 年 800G 及 1.6T 升級需求仍主要由可插拔光模組支撐。考
量上游基板供應風險及雷射產能吃緊，綜合研調單位預估及供應鏈訪查，2026/2027 年 800G 出貨
量達 4,500/7,500 萬支，年增 105%/67%；1.6T 則為 2,700/8,000 萬支，年增 1250%/196%。整體
市場規模將達分別為 490 億元/1066.8 億元，分別年增 154%/117%。

AI 晶片面積持續擴大，將使 ABF 載板用量大增 
隨著大型語言模型與生成式 AI 的算力需求快速攀升，AI 晶片的設計持續朝向更高運算密度與更大
面積發展。無論是 NVIDIA、AMD 或各家大廠的新世代加速器，都呈現晶粒尺寸擴大、功耗上升、
I/O 腳位數倍增的趨勢。在此背景下，ABF 載板的需求不僅以「量」擴張，更以「規格」升級為主
軸。為支撐大型 GPU/AI ASIC 的高頻寬連接與多晶片架構，ABF 層數、線寬線距、孔徑控制及翹
曲管理均需同步提升，帶動高端載板技術門檻不斷拉高。由於先進 AI 晶片的封裝面積更大、電源
與訊號整合更複雜，單顆晶片所需 ABF 載板面積與材料用量明顯增加。整體而言，AI 晶片規模擴
大正驅動 ABF 產業進入新一輪升級周期，高階需求將成為未來成長的主要動能。

獲利調整與股票評價  
給予臻鼎買進評等，目標價 680 元 
展望  2026-27 年 ， 臻 鼎 將 以 上 述 三 大 產 品 為 未 來 營 運 核 心 ， 2026/2027 年臻鼎營收為
2180/2796.8 億元，年增 19.4%/28.3%，其中 Server/光模組/載板營收合計於 2026/2027 年將分別
佔 23%/37% ，YoY+119%/121% ， 毛 利 率 則受 惠 高 毛 利產 品 帶 動至23.9%/28.7%， 營 業利 益
190.5/420.4 億元，年增 36.8/120.7%，稅後獲利 122.3/303.1 億元，年增 80.1%/147.8%，EPS 
11.07/27.33 元。 
評價方面，短期觀察到現有業務及載板方面將陸續調整價格，長期而言考量臻鼎積極轉型且擴產進
度也超同業，且管理層目標 2030 年行動通訊營收占比將降至 35-40%、電腦消費將降至 15-20%、
伺服器/光模塊/IC 載板將從目前的 22%提升至 45-50%，且該產品線毛利遠優於現有業務，後續將
陸續看到營運體質改善，因此若以相關同業光模塊 /載板族群本益比多往 20-30 倍區間靠攏，本中
心給予臻鼎 25 倍本益比，並以 2027 年 EPS 推得目標價 680 元，給予買進投資建議。

公司簡介  
臻鼎科技控股成立於 2006 年，前身可追溯至 1978 年成立的華虹電子，2006 年 FOXCONN ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY 
LIMITED 於在開曼群島設立，2011 年於台灣證券交易所掛牌上市，現為全球第一大 PCB 製造商，鴻海集團持有臻鼎約三
成的股權。公司以「One ZDT」一站式服務平台為核心，產品布局涵蓋軟性印刷電路板（FPC）、高密度連接板（HDI）、
類載板（SLP）、高層數硬板（HLC/RPCB）、軟硬結合板（Rigid-Flex）、SMT 模組及 IC 載板（ABF／BT）等，應用橫
跨智慧型手機、PC 與消費性電子、網通設備、AI 伺服器、光模組、汽車電子及智慧穿戴等領域。 集團旗下主要子公司包
括鵬鼎控股、禮鼎科技、先豐通訊及佰鼎科技，生產據點主要分布於中國、台灣及泰國，並持續擴大高階 PCB 及 IC 載板
產能。公司營運重心逐步由傳統手機及 PC 應用向 AI 伺服器、光模組、IC 載板及 Edge AI 等高附加價值市場延伸，2026
年上半年伺服器／光模組／IC 載板合計營收占比已達 21.6%，成為下一階段主要成長動能。

【投資評等調整機制】  
  投資評等係「首次」給予特定個股投資評等時，其前一日收盤價相較 3 個月
目標價之潛在上漲空間計算而得。個股投資評等分為四個等級，定義如上。
爾後的投資評等係依循「首次評等」，直到停止推薦。   
「強力買進」、「買進」及「區間操作」均有 upside 目標價。差別僅在於，
首次評等時潛在報酬率不同。「中立」則無目標價。  
一旦我們給予特定個股「強力買進」 、 「買進」或「區間操作」之投資評等，
就是責任的開始，爾後將透過各式研究報告作定期性、持續性追蹤基本面及
股價變化，直到停止推薦。  
停止推薦情境：  
1.  達目標價。  
2.  雖未達原訂目標價，但檢視基本面、訊息面、籌碼面等多方訊息，研

利：展望 2H26 ，受惠超效能二極體 (ULLD) 訂單需求暢旺，加上
高毛利客製化 IGBT 之工業產品於 4Q26 開始小量量產，預估朋
程 2H26 營運有望呈現溫和增溫的態勢， 3Q26 及 4Q26 營收分
別有望季增 3.7% 及 5.1%，然而毛利率方面，因受原物料銅價上
揚及上游晶圓代工漲價影響，使 2H26 毛利率有所壓抑，研究部
預估較 1H26 平均毛利率約衰退 1.2pt 。預估朋程 2026 年營收為

展望 2027 年， ULLD 動能續強，靜待工業新品實質貢獻： 展望

然毛利率則預期因晶圓代工及原物料成本持續上揚，將抵銷產
品組合轉佳影響，預估朋程 2027 年毛利率將呈持穩態勢。綜上
所述 ， 研究部預估朋程2027 年營收為 93.06 億元 (YOY+10.9%) ，

  ESG(Environment, Social, Governance) ：  
朋程科技身為全球車用二極體與功率模組龍頭，將 ESG 視為企業永續的核
心，積極推動「綠色製造、誠信治理、社會共好」三大面向。  
一、環境保護（ Environmental ）：  
碳管理與淨零路徑：遵循 ISO 14064-1 完成全廠區溫室氣體盤查，推動 ISO 
50001 能源管理系統，並訂定 2050 淨零排放（ Net Zero ）長期目標。綠色產
品與節能低碳：主力產品「超高效率二極體（ LL-DIODE ）」顯著提升發電
機效率，協助全球燃油車及混動車降低二氧化碳排放。積極佈局 SiC（碳化
矽）與 IGBT 功率模組，推動電動車（ EV）與綠能逆變器高能效轉型。綠色
製造與資源循環：導入廢棄物資源化與節水設備，達成 ISO 14001 與 ISO 
45001 認證，落實有害物質禁用 (RoHS/REACH 規範 )。  
二、社會責任（ Social ）：  
人本關懷與職業安全：打造多元平等職場（ DEI ），提供完善薪酬福利與育
兒支持；連續多年獲得職業安全衛生優良單位人才培育與技術傳承：建立產
學合作計畫，補助員工持續教育，重視車用半導體研發人才之長期留任。  
供應鏈永續管理：制定《供應商行為準則》，要求供應商簽署不使用衝突礦
石（ Conflict-Free Minerals ）聲明，落實供應鏈環境與人權評核。社會參與
與公益：長期投入偏鄉教育、在地社區關懷與綠色植樹活動，回饋營運據點
周邊社區。  
三、公司治理（ Governance ）：  
誠信經營與資訊透明：設有獨立董事與審計委員會，定期進行板塊運作與董
事會績效評估 ， 保障股東與利益關係人權益 。 資訊安全與永續報告 ： 取得ISO 
27001 資訊安全管理認證，定期發布符合 GRI 準則與 SASB 規範之 ESG 永
續報告書。風險控管與韌性：建立地緣政治、氣候變遷風險（ TCFD ）與供
應鏈中斷之營運持續計畫（ BCP ）。

3 群益投顧 
公司簡介：  
朋程 (8255 TT) 成立於 1998 年，總部位於桃園市蘆竹區，是一家車用二極體
與功率半導體廠，為全球汽車發電機整流二極體最大供應商。公司目前業務
與產品分為四大核心領域， 1.一般整流二極體 (Standard Diode) ：主要應用於
傳統燃油車發電機，提供基本整流與車用電源轉化功能； 2.高效能二极體
(LLD / ULLD) ：包含高效能與超高效能二極體，具備低功耗與高轉換效率特
性，以因應各國車輛碳排放與節能法規要求； 3.新能源車功率模組 (EV Power 
Module) ：專注於油電混合動力車之逆變器、主驅動模組，並透過旗下子公
司安捷特布局矽 (Si) 與第三代半導體碳化矽 (SiC) 、氮化鎵 (GaN) 晶片設計與
封裝； 4.工控與特殊應用 (Industrial & Others) ：包含工業用 IGBT 模組、 AI
伺服器電源管理及儲能系統功率半導體解決方案。 2026 年銷售區域以亞洲
市場 (含中國大陸 )為主要營收來源，北美與歐洲次之。 2025 年營收產品
別 :Diode 佔 29% 、 LLD 佔 28% 、 ULLD 佔 21% 、 xEV 佔 17% 。

歐洲客戶拉貨放緩， 2Q26 本業獲利 YOY 下滑：  
朋程 2Q26 營收 20.32 億元 (QOQ-0.3%/YOY-6.1%) ，不如市場預期，主因受
歐洲客戶拉貨放緩，使 48V MOSFET 模組出貨量顯著放緩，毛利率 26.98% ，
與前季維持相當，費用率 20.60% ，與前季一致，本業獲利 1.3 億元， YOY
下滑 44.5% ，惟業外方面，因 25 年受匯損低基期影響，稅後淨利為 1.46 億
元 (QOQ-15.4%/YOY+276.3%) ，稅後 EPS 1.44 元。

預估 2H26 營運逐季增溫，惟原物料及代工成本上揚，壓抑獲利：  
展望 2H26 ，受惠超效能二極體 (ULLD) 訂單需求暢旺，加上高毛利客製化
IGBT 之工業產品於 4Q26 開始小量量產，預估朋程 2H26 營運有望呈現溫
和增溫的態勢， 3Q26 及 4Q26 營收分別有望季增 3.7% 及 5.1% ，然而毛利率
方面，因受原物料銅價上揚及上游晶圓代工漲價影響，使 2H26 毛利率有所
壓抑，研究部預估較 1H26 平均毛利率約衰退 1.2pt 。整體產能預估方面，
Diode( 一般二極體 )約 1.3 億 ~1.4 億顆， LLD( 低功耗二極體 )7200 萬 ~7500 萬
顆， ULLD( 超高效二極體 )4000 萬 ~4200 萬顆， xEV( 新能源車模組 )接近 300
萬顆。綜上所述，預估朋程 2026 年營收為 83.88 億元 (YOY+3.5%) ，毛利率
26.35%(YOY-0.4%pt) ，稅後淨利為 6.17 億元 (YOY-4%) ，稅後 EPS 6.06 元，
獲利較 2025 年呈微幅衰退。

展望 2027 年， ULLD 接單動能續強，靜待工業事業發酵：  
展望 2027 年，因各國碳排法規越來越嚴 格，車廠需要降低燃油車的油耗與
廢氣。 ULLD 可以直接替換傳統整流二極體，提升發電機效率、降低發熱量
與碳排，不需要車廠大幅改動整車電氣架構，為成本最低的減碳方案，使目
前 ULLD 接單動能續強。 ULLD 單價是傳統二極體的達 6 倍，在產線滿載
與出貨增長的帶動下，可有效填補傳統二極體及 LLD 下滑影響。此外，新
產品方面，公司表示， IGBT 新產能將於 4Q26 起開始放量，單月出貨量將
達 150K ，並預計於 1Q27 單季出貨量將從 500K 逐季提升至 800K ，此項產
品高於公司平均毛利率。而 SIC 方面，項目尚在送樣驗證階段，將聚焦 AI、

  投資評等係「首次」給予特定個股投資評等時，其前一日收盤價相較 3 個月

爾後的投資評等係依循「首次評等」，直到停止推薦。

首次評等時潛在報酬率不同。「中立」則無目標價。  
一旦我們給予特定個股「強力買進」 、 「買進」或「區間操作」之投資評等，
就是責任的開始，爾後將透過各式研究報告作定期性、持續性追蹤基本面及
股價變化，直到停止推薦。  
停止推薦情境：  
1.  達目標價。  
2.  雖未達原訂目標價，但檢視基本面、訊息面、籌碼面等多方訊息，研
判股價上漲空間已然有限，將適時出具降評報告。

貳、公 司 營 運 概 況

一.公司簡介  
巨大成立於 1972 年，資 本 額39.21 億元 ， 並於1994 年掛牌上市。
巨大為全球最大的自行車製造商 ， 早期以外銷導向的OEM 自行車
專業製造為主， 1981 年以自創品牌「 Giant 捷安特」開始於國內
銷售，銷售業務逐漸向海外發展。巨大主攻中高階自行車種為主，
從研發、製造、品牌、通路與售後服務，擁有完整供應體系，通
路遍佈北美 、 歐洲 、 澳洲 、 台灣與中國大陸 ， 通路據點多達10,000
個以上。巨大採取 ODM 與自有品牌並重的經營策略， ODM 與自
有品牌比重分別為 30% 與 70% ，主要 ODM 客戶為美國第一品牌
Trek 、歐洲品牌廠 Scott 與 Colnago 。歐美品牌雖擁有品牌與通
路，但大多缺乏製造與研發，其他台灣與中國大陸廠商雖擁有製
造實力，但缺乏品牌與通路，反觀巨大擁有研發、製造、品牌與
通路，完整經營價值鏈為巨大營運利基點。

圖一、巨大核心價值

資料來源：巨大法說簡報

二. 產能概況

巨大在全球共有八座生產基地，其中中國大陸四座、台灣一座與
歐洲荷蘭、匈牙利各一座與越南廠一座，合計年產能 626 萬台。

台灣大甲廠廠，成立於 1981 年，規劃年產能 90 萬台，生產高附
加價值產品為主，如電動自行車與高階自行車，主要以外銷歐美
市場為主。江蘇昆山廠，成立於 1992 年，規劃年產能 150 萬台，
內外銷各半 。 歐洲荷蘭廠 ， 成立於1996 年 ， 規劃年產能30 萬台，
主要以組裝電動自行車為主，主打歐洲市場。

二. 2026 年營運概況及展望

觀察巨大 2025 年營收區域別 ， 其中歐洲比重42%、 北美地區9%、
中國地區（自行車與其他配件） 26%、台灣地區 8%，其他地區比
重 15% 。巨大歷史經驗來觀察， 3Q 為公司旺季，主要原因在於
3Q 對應半年為歐美春夏季節，騎自行車人數相對較多，加上新款
車種皆在 3Q 出貨，單價也較其他三季來的高。

巨大 2025 年營收金額 602.54 億元， YoY-15.47% 。巨大 2025 年
整體出貨量 330 萬台， YoY-16.46% ，其中電動自行車 2025 年出
貨量 51.6 萬台 ，YoY+6.83% ，貢 獻2025 年營收金額 142.7 億元，
YoY-11.02%； 在傳統自行車方面 ，2025 年傳統自行車出貨量 278.4
萬台， YoY-19.7% ，貢獻 2025 年營收金額 427.9 億元，
YoY-17.44% ， Youbike 業務 2025 年營收金額 31.9 億元，
YoY-6.42% 。

觀察巨大 2025 年歐洲地區營收金額 253.07 億元， YoY+4.4% ；
北美地區營收金額 54.23 億元 ，YoY-15.5%； 中國大陸地區營收金
額 156.66 億元， YoY-42.12% 。

巨大 2026 年營運概況

巨大 01~08/2026 營收金額 401.31 億元， YoY-6.11% 。觀察歐洲
地區 2026 年市場逐漸緩慢復甦，巨大將持續推出新款 E-BIKE ，
將有助歐洲市場回溫；中國大陸在內需市場消費動能有限，價格
持續競爭與高基期影響，預期營運將衰退；北美地區受到 WRO
禁運影響新產品供貨，加上消費者消費力道偏保守，預期北美市
場將呈現下滑。綜合上述。宏遠預估 2026 年電動自行車出貨量
54.5 萬台， YoY+5.62%( 其中 OEM 35 萬台，年增率 -10.3% ，自
有品牌 19.5 萬台，年增率 53.54%) ，預估貢獻巨大 2026 年營收
金額 163.5 億元， YoY+14.58% ；在傳統自行車方面，預估 2026
年傳統自行車出貨量 258 萬台，YoY-7.33% ，貢獻巨大 2026 年營
收金額 399.5 億元， YoY-6.64% ；Youbike 業務 2026 年營收金額
34 億元，YoY+6.5% 。宏遠預估巨大 2026 年整體出貨量 312.5 萬
台， YoY-5.30% ，預估巨大 2026 年合併營收金額 597.0 億元，
YoY-0.92% 。

巨大 2027 年營運概況

巨大 2027 年營運重點包括：歐洲市場仍呈現溫和復甦態勢，巨大
將持續推新品提升市場滲透率；美國方面，在 WRO 禁運不利因
素己排除，預期美國市場將呈現成長態勢；中國市場在中低價車
款需求持續回溫 ， 預期將恢復成長格局 。 綜合上述 。 宏遠預估2027
年電動自行車出貨量 60 萬台，YoY+10.09% ，預估貢獻巨大 2027
年營收金額 192 億元， YoY+17.43% ；在傳統自行車方面，預估
2027 年傳統自行車出貨量 270 萬台 ，YoY+4.65%， 貢獻巨大2027
年營收金額 420 億元，YoY+5.13% ；Youbike 業務 2027 年營收金
額 36 億元， YoY+5.88% 。宏遠預估巨大 2027 年整體出貨量 330
萬台， YoY+5.6% ，預估巨大 2027 年合併營收金額 648 億元，
YoY+8.54% 。

消費 
非必需品消費前景黯淡  
重要訊息  
本期 Radar Monthly －消費產業，我們提供：(1)全球運動休閒品牌商財報回
顧；(2)中東衝突對消費影響 ；與 (3) 消費產業 8 月營收回顧。  
評論及分析 
全球運動休閒品牌 2Q26 庫存天數創疫後新高，供應鏈訂單不確定將持續至
4Q26- 1Q27 。國際運動休閒品牌及零售商 2Q26 整體庫存天數飆升至 142
天，年增 8%、季增 13%，創下疫後新高並遠高於歷史平均值之 108 天 (圖
1)；其中，儘管多數品牌庫存數量保持低檔，但在原物料價格上揚與美國關
稅推升產品售價之影響下，客流量及商品轉換率普遍轉差。加上美國實質工
資負成長將壓抑消費動能 (圖 2)，多數品牌計畫維持採購緊縮策略，以應對
2H26 銷售競爭加劇。我們預估，產業庫存調整恐需耗時至少兩個季度，這意
味著，台灣成衣及製鞋供應鏈訂單不確定性將持續至 4Q26-1Q27，且稼動率
不足將延緩利潤率復甦前景。 
中東衝突激化，油價攀升使通膨及升息預期升溫並抑制消費。 中東局勢自 7
月美伊破局以來持續激化。除荷姆茲海峽持續有船隻遭攻擊外，伊朗支持之
胡塞武裝與沙烏地阿拉伯及葉門政府軍的衝突也再擴大，布蘭特油價攀升至
100 元以上，較 6 月低點反彈超過 40%。能源價格高漲引發通膨及升息預期
升溫，十年期美國公債殖利率攀升至 4.97% ，較 6 月低點增加約 0.6 個百分
點。凱基認為中東局勢引發的高能源價格，短時間難以解除，對消費衝擊主
要體現在 1.)物價上漲引發通膨，降低實質購買力以及 2.) 能源價格上漲排擠
非必需消費支出。整體來說，我們維持對非必需消費保守看法，消費產業中
建議關注利基型消費，如自行車、隱形眼鏡等 。 
消費產業 8 月營收回顧，運輸類別為最大亮點。 消費產業 8 月營收亮點為運
輸(航空、貨櫃航運、散裝航運) 及隱形眼鏡。其中貨櫃航運、散裝航運營收分
別年增 54%、30%，反映中東衝突外溢效應，包括可用運力限縮、燃油附加
費轉嫁、能源價格高昂使煤炭替代需求增加等。航空營收年增 28%，成長來
自燃油附加費調 漲，以及出境旅遊與 AI 半導體出口暢旺。隱形眼鏡營收年增
29% ，成長來自中國彩片需求熱絡。  
投資建議 
能源價格高漲不利非必需性消費，建議朝向較不受總體變數影響的利基型消
費個股，以及高運價支撐獲利之運輸類股佈局操作，包括巨大 (9921 TT ，
NT$89.7 ， 增加持股)、 美利達(9914 TT，NT$68.7， 增加持股)、視 陽(6782 TT ，
NT$227.0 ， 增加持股)、望 隼(4771 TT，NT$204.0 ， 增加持股)、鈊 象(3293 TT ，
NT$699，增加持股) 、陽明(2609 TT，NT$59.3，增加持股 )、萬海(261 5 TT，
NT$113.0 ，增加持股) 。 
投資風險 
地緣政治衝突擴大、通膨及利率變化、美國關稅政策變化。  
焦點內容  
1. 國際運動休閒品牌 2Q26 整體庫存天
數季增 13%至 142 天，創疫後新高。
台灣供應鏈訂單不確定性將持續至
4Q26~1Q27，且稼動率不足將延緩利
潤率復甦前景。 
2. 中東局勢持續激化 ， 能源價格高漲推升
通膨及升息預期， 不利非必需消費 。 建
議關注利基型消費如自行車、隱形眼
鏡。 
3. 消費類股 8 月營收亮點集中於運輸類股
(貨櫃、散裝、航空 )以及隱形眼鏡，營
收分別年增 54%、30%、28%、29% 。

台灣隱形眼鏡業者 8 月營收成長加速 
1. 台灣隱形眼鏡廠商 8 月合併營收年增
29%，成長動能較前月進一步加速，  主
要受惠產能持續擴充以及客戶訂單需求
強勁。 
2. 隨著矽水膠及多焦點隱形 眼鏡陸續上
市，業者預期營收將延續逐季成長趨勢
至年底，優於過往季節性。  
3. 我們看好台灣隱形眼鏡業者獲利表現具
上修空間，因為營收成長動能轉強，將
帶動產能利用率提升及產品組合優化，
進一步推升毛利率與獲利能力。

暑假旺季，航空股 8 月營收維持高檔 
1. 航空股 8 月營收月增 0%、年增 28%，
年增大幅成長來自燃油附加費調漲、 AI
半導體出口需求暢旺使貨運單位收益增
加。 
2. 長榮航及華航 8 月營收月增分別為
+2.0% 及-1.3% ，維持暑假旺季水準。 
3. 中東衝突持續激化，航空燃油價格已回
升至每桶 180 美元以上，較 6 月低點回
升超過 60%，將壓抑航空業 4Q26 獲利
爆發性。 
1.  
貨櫃航運股 8 月營收續創近兩年新高 
1. 貨櫃航運股 8 月營收月增 3%、年增
54%， 美國商品補庫存運輸需求強勁 ， 。 
2. 8 月 SCFI 綜合指數月增 7%至 3388 點，
預期貨櫃航運股 9 月營收將繼續保持月
增成長，且營收連續 6 個月成長將創
2021 年以來最佳紀錄。 
3. SCFI 綜合指數 、 歐線 、 美西線 、 美東線、
近洋線， 7/31 至今累計漲幅分別為
14% 、-21%、18%、16%、61%。漲
幅集中於美線及近洋 線，為萬海主要航
線，預期獲利上修空間較長榮及陽明更
大。

美股焦點

Gap ( 美) 主力品牌面臨銷售壓力，庫存天數飆升  
Gap ( 美) 2Q FY26 (5 -7 月；財年止於 1 月) 營收年減 2%至 36.5 億美元，低
於指引之年減 0-1%， 主因主力品牌Old Navy 女裝季節性商品面臨銷售壓力 ，
且客流量意外放緩，導致同店銷售下滑，抵銷 Gap 品牌銷售延續 9%成長。
再加上地緣政治動盪推升在途存貨數量，2 Q FY26 庫存天數飆高至 115 天，
年增 27%、季增 23%，遠高於過去十年同期平均之 91 天。公司調降 FY26
營收展望，並已採取針對性應對措施，力圖重振 Old Navy 產品需求。

Lululemon (加 ) 2Q FY26 ( 5-7 月；財年止於 1 月) 營收年減 4%至 24.2 億美
元，低於公司展望之 2-3%衰退，主因社群媒體負面評論影響客流量，也導致
部分新產品上市後反應不如預期。2Q FY26 庫存天數再度攀升至 160 天，年
增 11%、季增 19%，遠高於過去十年同期平均水準之 131 天。儘管公司已
調整產品組合，但至目前新品發布反響仍不穩定，主力市場銷售持續有壓。
管理層預計 3Q FY26 營收減幅將進一步惡化至 10-11%。

零售

圖 51：零售產業摘要  圖 52：7 月台灣零售銷售維持穩健成長 
1. 台灣 7 月零售銷售年增 7.7%，維持穩健成長動能，主要受惠車市
買氣回溫、暑假娛樂與 購物需求，以及多元行銷活動挹注；其中
百貨公司表現最佳，年增 9.6%，超級市場與便利商店則分別年增 
6.0% 與 4.2%。 
2. 7 月餐飲業銷售年增僅 2.5%，成長幅度較 6 月的 4.6%放緩，主
要因颱風假停班停課影響消費。 
3. 中國消費持續成長，餐飲收入七月年增率由 1.2% 升至 1.4%，惟
零售銷售增速放緩，年增率由 1.0% 降至 0.6%。

觀光

圖 59：觀光產業摘要  圖 60：台灣入境旅客減少 
1. 台灣飯店業者 8 月合併營收年增 7%，對比過去 10 年平均成長幅
度為 5%，主要受惠季節性餐飲銷售表現穩健，以及休閒旅遊需
求持續增溫。 
2. 台灣 7 月入境旅客人數年增 4.5%。主要區域中，歐洲旅客年增
25.7%，成長最快；美洲及亞洲旅客分別年增 6.0% 及 3.4%，大
洋洲旅客則年減 6.8%。 
3. 隨觀光需求逐步復甦，台灣飯店 2Q26 平均房價年增 3.8%，延
續成長趨勢；住房率則年增 0.5 個百分點，維持穩定。

強勁，美線運價達到 2022 年以來新高。 
2. Maersk(丹)、Hapeg-Lloyd(德)、CMA CGM(法)等頭部航商陸續重返
試航紅海航道，蘇伊士運河通行量小幅回升。 
3. 亞洲颱風活動活躍，上海及寧波港 8 月以來數度中斷營運，積壓

地運力超過 500 萬 TEU，佔全球總運力達 14.6%。 
4. 9 月起進入北美穀物出口旺季，疊加巴拿馬運河降載衝擊 ，散裝運

3. 桃園機場 7 月處理貨量年增率由 12.3%大幅下降至 3.7%，主要

4. 中東衝突持續激化，航空燃油價格已回升至每桶 180 美元以上，
較 6 月低點回升超過 60%，將壓抑航空業 4Q26 獲利爆發性。

Institutional Investor (II) ranked us as the No.1 IRP in 2022.
TAG (the Technology Advisory Group) is Aletheia’s premier technology research division and
focuses on global hardware/semiconductor, aiming to deliver differentiated, timely and value-
added services.
Our research approach is based on long-term and sustainable themes, and a principles-based
investment thesis, that is, rising content value, share gain, pricing power and monopoly in
supply & demand as well as an integrated/holistic approach.

Our subscription-based business model is supported by a wide range of clients - SWFs, LOs,
large platform HFs, L/S HFs, family offices and corporates across the globe.
Subscriptions to TAG’s services are available through hard dollar or CSA arrangements. We
have official relationships with CSA brokers BAML, JPM, UBS, GS, MS, Instinet, BTIG/Fubon,
Cathay Securities and Sinolink Securities.

Source PDF: all report pdf/【國泰證期研究部】4Q26特化產業展望-先進封裝材料隱含價值持續提升-20260909.pdf
Report source: line報告備份
Date: 2026-09-09
Pages: 7
Status: ok

### Page 1

1 
4Q26特化產業展望 
 先進封裝材料隱含價值持續提升

### Page 2

2 
投資 顧問 
產業報告 
 2026/09/09

4Q26特化產業展望 
先進封裝材料隱含價值持續提升 
結論與建議 
綜觀2026 Semicon，整體展會重點圍繞在先進封裝與測試，包括FOPLP、TGV、CPO
等新興技術皆為本次展會重要議題。在半導體材料供應鏈方面，在地化持續加速，在地
化趨勢由前段先進製程拓展至後段先進封裝。市場上台廠的先進封裝材料呈現百花齊
放，除了先進封裝材料供應商相繼發表創新解決方案，如家登、新應材、崇越等原先於
前段先進製程已穩居市場龍頭的廠商，亦紛紛依循此趨勢將戰線跨足至先進封裝領域，
深化營運佈局。 
4Q26投資展望  
1. 綜觀2026 Semicon，整 體 展 會 重 點 圍 繞 在 先 進 封 裝 與 測 試，包 括FOPLP、TGV、CPO
等新興技術皆為本次展會重要議題，整體產業主軸已由前段製程不斷微縮演進，逐步
轉向先進封裝，先進封裝也從單純的封裝，轉往散熱、光互連與測試的系統級整合。 
2. 台廠材料供應商已逐漸從傳統單一產品的供應者，轉型為具備高整合度與技術支援能
力的策略夥伴。面對晶圓廠客戶對先進製程、高良率與量產穩定度的高度要求，本土
材料商傾向提供涵蓋產品線橫向整合、客製化協同研發與在地化及時技術支援的全方
位一站式解決方案 
3. 先進封裝膠帶再度成為市場關注焦點。半導體膠帶的角色正由單純的晶圓研磨、切割
過程中的保護與固定耗材，逐步延伸至翹曲控制、暫時接著／解離、 載板支撐及
Molding脫模等更高附加價值製程。相關台廠如山太士（3595 TT）、新寶紘。 
4. 台積電發表的A16 製程技術將於4Q26 年量產，其中晶背供電技術為關鍵技術。中
砂（1560 TT）、 昇 陽 半 （8028 TT）直 接 受 惠 程 度 最 高。中 砂 方 面，隨 製 程 道 數 增 加 且
鑽石碟 life time 縮短，將大幅提升鑽石碟用量。研究部預估A16 整體研磨市場規模
將比 N2 成長 20~30%；昇 陽 半 則 受 惠 於 隨 製 程 越 演 先 進，製 程 中 設 備 需 測 試 調 校 之
參數眾多，帶動檔控片用量大幅提升。

先進封裝材料隱含價值持續提升 
台廠材料商從單一產品供應者轉型為一站式解決方案的策略夥伴 
綜觀2026 Semicon，整體展會重點圍繞在先進封裝與測試，包括FOPLP、TGV、CPO等新興
技術皆為本次展會重要議題，顯示整體產業主軸已由前段製程不斷微縮演進 ， 逐步轉向先進封裝 ，
先進封裝也從單純的封裝，轉往散熱、光互連與測試的系統級整合。 
在半導體材料供應鏈方面，在地化持續加速，在地化趨勢由前段先進製程拓展至後段先進封裝。
市場上台廠的先進封裝材料呈現百花齊放，除了先進封裝材料供應商相繼發表創新解決方案，如
家登、新應材、崇越等原先於前段先進製程已穩居市場龍頭的廠商，亦紛紛依循此趨勢將戰線跨
足至先進封裝領域，深化營運佈局。 
台廠材料供應商已逐漸從傳統單一產品的供應者 ， 轉型為具備高整合度與技術支援能力的策略夥
伴。面對晶圓廠客戶對先進製程、高良率與量產穩定度的高度要求，本土材料商傾向提供涵蓋產
品線橫向整合、客製化協同研發與在地化及時技術支援的全方位一站式解決方案，不僅能顯著降
低客戶導入新材料的測試成本與製程風險，更透過發揮在地供應鏈的反應優勢協助快速排查異常，
進而深植客戶黏著度，奠定雙方不可或缺的半導體在地供應鏈夥伴關係。

先進封裝膠帶再度成為市場關注焦點 
在本次Semicon中，我 們 看 見 先 進 封 裝 膠 帶 為 一 大 重 點。隨AI GPU、ASIC及HBM帶動CoWoS、
FOWLP、FOPLP等先進封裝快速發展 ， 半導體膠帶的角色正由單純的晶圓研磨 、 切割過程中的保護
與固定耗材，逐步延伸至翹曲控制、暫時接著／解離、載板支撐及Molding脫模等更高附加價值製
程。先進封裝大量導入RDL、Molding Compound、玻璃或其他Carrier，且有機與無機材料的熱
膨脹係數不同 ， 隨封裝面積放大及RDL層數增加 ， 製程中的熱循環容易使應力持續累積 ， 造成Wafer
或Panel翹曲；若翹曲超出設備可處理範圍，將直接影響曝光對位、晶圓搬送、植球及後續回焊等
製程。因此，膠膜的功能已不只是「黏住再撕掉」 ，而必須進一步具備應力調控、耐高溫、耐酸鹼、
低殘膠及可控制解黏等特性，使功能性膠帶開始成為影響先進封裝製程良率與效率的重要材料。

山太士（3595 TT）的應力平衡膜可從RDL製程前段開始抑制翹曲，可搭配玻璃、藍寶石、陶瓷等
載板，並針對不同方向補償應力，處理等向、洋芋片狀或扭轉型翹曲，隨線路與材料層數增加，應
力持續上升，可於不同製程階段增貼；完成Molding後、移除玻璃載板前，可先在Molding 
Compound表面貼上另一系列平衡膜 ， 再移除載板背面的原平衡膜及玻璃載板 ， 使元件與Molding 
Compound保持平整，以利後續植錫球、切割及回焊。 
除了應力平衡膜，山太士的暫時接著膜正在推進中，材料特性可承受真空、高溫及酸鹼等濕式化學
製程 ， 製程完成後再以雷射解離並移除玻璃載板 。 液態旋轉塗布晶圓暫時改用膜材，在 製 程 更 精 簡，
需要時間將大幅縮短。 
新應材本次除了展出自家公司產品外，與過往不同的是此次另外展出新寶紘與昱鐳應材(7932 TT)產
品。新寶紘除了展示過去市場熟悉的研磨膠帶BG T ape與切割膠帶Dicing T ape，另外展出處理翹
曲控制的Warpage Control Film（WCF）及離形膜Release Film。BG T ape針對高凸塊及超薄晶
圓製程設計，可支援約65–240 μm Bump高度、DBG／SDBG及TAIKO等薄化流程，UV Dicing 
Ta p e則利用UV照射後降低黏著力，兼顧切割時固定與挑晶時低殘膠需求。WCF可貼附於Wafer
或Panel背面，利用材料熱機械特性抵銷應力，且同時布局非Molding製程的翹曲控制，反映產品
定位已由單純製程膠帶向先進封裝翹曲管理材料延伸。

晶背供電正式落地，相關供應鏈值得關注 
中砂（1560 TT）、 昇 陽 半 （8028 TT）直接受惠程度最高 
台積電發表的A16 製程技術將於4Q26 年量產，其中晶背供電技術為關鍵技術。晶背供電將供
電的線路移至晶圓背面，主要是使用奈米矽穿孔技術(nTSV)，將晶圓正面的元件連接到背面的埋
入式電源軌(BPR)，電源透過晶背直接傳到電晶體的源極和汲極，可減少壓降(IR drop)和訊號延

1. 富世達 2Q26 受 AI 平台及手機產品轉換影響，營收短期下滑，惟伺服器
快接頭占比提升與製程改善帶動獲利率優於預期 ；3Q26 隨 GB300 維持高
檔、VR200 及 Trainium 3 逐步放量，預期營運創單季新高。 
2. 富世達 26 年受惠 GPU、ASIC 快接頭需求成長，預估營收年增 45.2%、
EPS 62.68 元；27 年隨 Rubin 與 Trainium 3 貢獻完整年度營收，加上
Rubin Ultra 導入 ZQD 規格升級，預估營收年增 60.4%、EPS 110.13 元。

比區間 12～38x 中間偏下位置，考量 AI 伺服器液冷需求持續擴張，快接
頭應用範圍逐步擴大，帶動單機櫃 QD 用量、產品價值量與獲利率提升，
維持買進投資建議，維持 25 倍本益比，目標價由 2,260 元(25x 修正前
27(F) PER)調升至 2,750 元(25x 修正後 27(F) PER)。
